name: XiLab.thTerm_nonneg
statement: lemma thTerm_nonneg (k n : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : 0 ≤ thTerm k n u
proof:
:= by
  unfold thTerm
  have : (0:ℝ) ≤ π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  positivity

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_thTerm
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_thTerm (k n : ℕ) (u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (thTerm k n) (-2 * Real.exp (2 * u) * thTerm (k + 1) n u) u
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => 2 * v) (2 : ℝ) u := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul (2 : ℝ)
  have e2 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * v)) (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2) u := h2.exp
  have hb : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v))))
      (Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) *
        (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2)))) u :=
    ((e2.const_mul (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2)).neg).exp
  have hmul := hb.const_mul ((π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ k)
  have hfun : thTerm k n = fun v : ℝ =>
      (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ k * Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v))) := rfl
  have heq : -2 * Real.exp (2 * u) * thTerm (k + 1) n u
      = (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ k * (Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) *
        (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2)))) := by
    simp only [thTerm]; ring
  rw [hfun, heq]
  exact hmul

name: XiLab.summable_thBound
statement: theorem summable_thBound (k : ℕ) (a : ℝ) : Summable (thBound k a)
proof:
:=
  (summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (2 * k)
    (norm_exp_neg_pi_exp_lt_one a)).mul_left _

name: XiLab.abs_thTerm_le
statement:
lemma abs_thTerm_le (k n : ℕ) {a u : ℝ} (hau : a ≤ u) :
    |thTerm k n u| ≤ thBound k a n
proof:
:= by
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have hE : Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) ≤
      Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n := by
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
    have ha' : Real.exp (2 * a) ≤ Real.exp (2 * u) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    have hnn : (n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := cast_le_sq n
    have s1 : (n : ℝ) * (π * Real.exp (2 * a)) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (π * Real.exp (2 * a)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnn (by positivity)
    have s2 : π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * a) ≤ π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha' (by positivity)
    nlinarith [s1, s2]
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (thTerm_nonneg k n u), thTerm, thBound]
  have hpow : (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ k = π ^ k * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) := by
    rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
  rw [hpow]
  calc π ^ k * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) * Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)))
      ≤ π ^ k * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (by positivity)
    _ = π ^ k * ((n : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n) := by ring

name: XiLab.abs_thTermDeriv_le
statement:
lemma abs_thTermDeriv_le (k n : ℕ) {a b u : ℝ} (hau : a ≤ u) (hub : u ≤ b) :
    |(-2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (2 * u) * thTerm (k + 1) n u| ≤
      2 * Real.exp (2 * b) * thBound (k + 1) a n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : |thTerm (k + 1) n u| ≤ thBound (k + 1) a n := abs_thTerm_le _ _ hau
  have h2 : Real.exp (2 * u) ≤ Real.exp (2 * b) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have heq : |(-2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (2 * u) * thTerm (k + 1) n u| =
      2 * Real.exp (2 * u) * |thTerm (k + 1) n u| := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    norm_num
  rw [heq]
  refine mul_le_mul (by linarith) h1 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)

name: XiLab.summable_thTerm
statement: theorem summable_thTerm (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => thTerm k n u)
proof:
:= by
  refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (summable_thBound k u) (fun n => ?_)
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using abs_thTerm_le k n (le_refl u)

name: XiLab.summable_thTerm_succ
statement: theorem summable_thTerm_succ (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => thTerm k (n + 1) u)
proof:
:=
  (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (summable_thTerm k u)

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_T
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_T (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (T k) (-2 * Real.exp (2 * x) * T (k + 1) x) x
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : x ∈ Ioo (x - 1) (x + 1) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hsum : Summable
      (fun n : ℕ => 2 * Real.exp (2 * (x + 1)) * thBound (k + 1) (x - 1) (n + 1)) :=
    (((summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (summable_thBound (k + 1) (x - 1)))).mul_left _
  have key := hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected
    (u := fun n : ℕ => 2 * Real.exp (2 * (x + 1)) * thBound (k + 1) (x - 1) (n + 1))
    (g := fun n : ℕ => thTerm k (n + 1))
    (g' := fun (n : ℕ) (v : ℝ) => -2 * Real.exp (2 * v) * thTerm (k + 1) (n + 1) v)
    hsum isOpen_Ioo isPreconnected_Ioo
    (fun n y _ => hasDerivAt_thTerm k (n + 1) y)
    (fun n y hy => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact abs_thTermDeriv_le k (n + 1) hy.1.le hy.2.le)
    hmem (summable_thTerm_succ k x) hmem
  have hrw : (-2 * Real.exp (2 * x) * T (k + 1) x)
      = ∑' n : ℕ, (-2 * Real.exp (2 * x) * thTerm (k + 1) (n + 1) x) := by
    rw [T, tsum_mul_left]
  rw [hrw]
  exact key

name: XiLab.differentiable_T
statement: theorem differentiable_T (k : ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (T k)
proof:
:=
  fun x => (hasDerivAt_T k x).differentiableAt

name: XiLab.tsum_int_thTerm
statement:
lemma tsum_int_thTerm (u : ℝ) :
    (∑' m : ℤ, Real.exp (-(π * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)))) = 1 + 2 * T 0 u
proof:
:= by
  set g : ℤ → ℝ := fun m => Real.exp (-(π * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) with hg
  have h1 : (fun n : ℕ => g ((n : ℤ) + 1)) = fun n : ℕ => thTerm 0 (n + 1) u := by
    funext n
    simp only [hg, thTerm, pow_zero, one_mul]
    norm_num
  have h2 : (fun n : ℕ => g (-((n : ℤ) + 1))) = fun n : ℕ => thTerm 0 (n + 1) u := by
    funext n
    simp only [hg, thTerm, pow_zero, one_mul]
    norm_num
    ring
  have hs1 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => g ((n : ℤ) + 1)) := by
    rw [h1]; exact summable_thTerm_succ 0 u
  have hs2 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => g (-((n : ℤ) + 1))) := by
    rw [h2]; exact summable_thTerm_succ 0 u
  have hz : g 0 = 1 := by simp [hg]
  rw [tsum_of_add_one_of_neg_add_one hs1 hs2, h1, h2, hz, T]
  ring

name: XiLab.rpow_half_exp
statement: lemma rpow_half_exp (u : ℝ) : (Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = Real.exp u
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), Real.log_exp]
  ring_nf

name: XiLab.theta_FE
statement: theorem theta_FE (u : ℝ) : 1 + 2 * T 0 (-u) = Real.exp u * (1 + 2 * T 0 u)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp (2 * u) := Real.exp_pos _
  have key := Real.tsum_exp_neg_mul_int_sq ha
  have hL : (∑' m : ℤ, Real.exp (-π * Real.exp (2 * u) * (m : ℝ) ^ 2)) = 1 + 2 * T 0 u := by
    rw [← tsum_int_thTerm u]
    congr 1; funext m; congr 1; ring
  have hR : (∑' m : ℤ, Real.exp (-π / Real.exp (2 * u) * (m : ℝ) ^ 2)) = 1 + 2 * T 0 (-u) := by
    rw [← tsum_int_thTerm (-u)]
    congr 1; funext m; congr 1
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) * (-u) = -(2 * u) by ring, Real.exp_neg]
    field_simp
  rw [hL, hR, rpow_half_exp] at key
  have hexp : Real.exp u ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos u).ne'
  field_simp at key
  linarith [key]

name: XiLab.phiTerm_eq
statement:
lemma phiTerm_eq (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ) :
    phiTerm n u = 4 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * thTerm 2 n u -
      6 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * thTerm 1 n u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [phiTerm, thTerm]
  ring

name: XiLab.Phi_eq_T
statement:
theorem Phi_eq_T (u : ℝ) :
    Phi u = 4 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * T 2 u - 6 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * T 1 u
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 4 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * thTerm 2 (n + 1) u) :=
    (summable_thTerm_succ 2 u).mul_left _
  have h2 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 6 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * thTerm 1 (n + 1) u) :=
    (summable_thTerm_succ 1 u).mul_left _
  rw [Phi]
  have : (fun n : ℕ => phiTerm (n + 1) u) =
      fun n : ℕ => (4 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * thTerm 2 (n + 1) u) -
        (6 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * thTerm 1 (n + 1) u) := by
    funext n; exact phiTerm_eq (n + 1) u
  rw [this, h1.tsum_sub h2, tsum_mul_left, tsum_mul_left, T, T]

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_thP
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_thP (u : ℝ) : HasDerivAt thP (thQ u) u
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_T 0 u).const_mul (2 : ℝ)).const_add (1 : ℝ)
  have heq : thQ u = 2 * (-2 * Real.exp (2 * u) * T 1 u) := by unfold thQ; ring
  rw [heq]
  exact h

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_thQ
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_thQ (u : ℝ) : HasDerivAt thQ (thR u) u
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => 2 * v) (2 : ℝ) u := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul (2 : ℝ)
  have e2 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * v)) (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2) u := h2.exp
  have hc : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => -4 * Real.exp (2 * v)) (-4 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2)) u :=
    e2.const_mul (-4 : ℝ)
  have h := hc.mul (hasDerivAt_T 1 u)
  have heq : thR u = -4 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2) * T 1 u
      + -4 * Real.exp (2 * u) * (-2 * Real.exp (2 * u) * T 2 u) := by unfold thR; ring
  rw [heq]
  exact h

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_neg_self
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_neg_self (u : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => -v) (-1 : ℝ) u
proof:
:=
  hasDerivAt_neg' u

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_thP_neg
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_thP_neg (u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => thP (-v)) (-(thQ (-u))) u
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_thP (-u)).comp u (hasDerivAt_neg_self u)
  have heq : -(thQ (-u)) = thQ (-u) * (-1) := by ring
  rw [heq]
  exact h

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_thQ_neg
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_thQ_neg (u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => thQ (-v)) (-(thR (-u))) u
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_thQ (-u)).comp u (hasDerivAt_neg_self u)
  have heq : -(thR (-u)) = thR (-u) * (-1) := by ring
  rw [heq]
  exact h

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_negThQneg
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_negThQneg (u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => -(thQ (-v))) (thR (-u)) u
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_thQ_neg u).neg
  have heq : thR (-u) = -(-(thR (-u))) := by ring
  rw [heq]
  exact h

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_expThP
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_expThP (u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp v * thP v)
      (Real.exp u * thP u + Real.exp u * thQ u) u
proof:
:=
  (Real.hasDerivAt_exp u).mul (hasDerivAt_thP u)

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_expThPQ
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_expThPQ (u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp v * thP v + Real.exp v * thQ v)
      ((Real.exp u * thP u + Real.exp u * thQ u)
        + (Real.exp u * thQ u + Real.exp u * thR u)) u
proof:
:=
  (hasDerivAt_expThP u).add ((Real.hasDerivAt_exp u).mul (hasDerivAt_thQ u))

name: XiLab.theta_FE_P
statement: theorem theta_FE_P (u : ℝ) : thP (-u) = Real.exp u * thP u
proof: := theta_FE u

name: XiLab.theta_FE_I
statement:
theorem theta_FE_I (u : ℝ) :
    -(thQ (-u)) = Real.exp u * thP u + Real.exp u * thQ u
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun v : ℝ => thP (-v)) = fun v : ℝ => Real.exp v * thP v := funext theta_FE_P
  have h1 := hasDerivAt_thP_neg u
  rw [hfun] at h1
  exact h1.unique (hasDerivAt_expThP u)

name: XiLab.theta_FE_II
statement:
theorem theta_FE_II (u : ℝ) :
    thR (-u) = (Real.exp u * thP u + Real.exp u * thQ u)
      + (Real.exp u * thQ u + Real.exp u * thR u)
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun v : ℝ => -(thQ (-v)))
      = fun v : ℝ => Real.exp v * thP v + Real.exp v * thQ v := funext theta_FE_I
  have h1 := hasDerivAt_negThQneg u
  rw [hfun] at h1
  exact h1.unique (hasDerivAt_expThPQ u)

name: XiLab.Phi_eq_thQR
statement: theorem Phi_eq_thQR (u : ℝ) : Phi u = 1 / 2 * Real.exp (u / 2) * (thQ u + thR u)
proof:
:= by
  have p1 : Real.exp (u / 2) * Real.exp (2 * u) = Real.exp (5 * u / 2) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  have p2 : Real.exp (u / 2) * (Real.exp (2 * u) * Real.exp (2 * u)) = Real.exp (9 * u / 2) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  rw [Phi_eq_T]
  unfold thQ thR
  linear_combination (-4 * T 2 u) * p2 + (6 * T 1 u) * p1

name: XiLab.Phi_even
statement: theorem Phi_even (u : ℝ) : Phi (-u) = Phi u
proof:
:= by
  have hI := theta_FE_I u
  have hII := theta_FE_II u
  have hsum : thQ (-u) + thR (-u) = Real.exp u * (thQ u + thR u) := by
    linear_combination hII - hI
  have hp : Real.exp (-u / 2) * Real.exp u = Real.exp (u / 2) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  rw [Phi_eq_thQR (-u), Phi_eq_thQR u, hsum]
  linear_combination (1 / 2 * (thQ u + thR u)) * hp

name: XiLab.deriv_Phi_zero
statement: theorem deriv_Phi_zero : deriv Phi 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun v : ℝ => Phi (-v)) = Phi := funext Phi_even
  have h0 : HasDerivAt Phi (deriv Phi (-(0 : ℝ))) (-(0 : ℝ)) :=
    (differentiable_Phi _).hasDerivAt
  have hneg : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Phi (-v)) (deriv Phi (-(0 : ℝ)) * (-1)) 0 :=
    h0.comp (0 : ℝ) (hasDerivAt_neg_self 0)
  rw [hfun, neg_zero] at hneg
  have hd : HasDerivAt Phi (deriv Phi 0) 0 := (differentiable_Phi 0).hasDerivAt
  have h := hneg.unique hd
  linarith

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_phiTerm'
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_phiTerm' (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (phiTerm' n) (phiTerm'' n u) u
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => 2 * v) (2 : ℝ) u := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul (2 : ℝ)
  have h5 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => 5 * v / 2) (5 / 2 : ℝ) u := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul (5 : ℝ)).div_const 2
  have e2 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * v)) (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2) u := h2.exp
  have e5 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (5 * v / 2))
      (Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * (5 / 2)) u := h5.exp
  have hW : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v))
      (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2)) u := e2.const_mul _
  have hEX : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v))))
      (Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) *
        (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2)))) u := hW.neg.exp
  have hWW : HasDerivAt
      (fun v : ℝ => π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v) * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v)))
      (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2) * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) +
        π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2))) u :=
    hW.mul hW
  have hsq : (fun v : ℝ =>
      π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v) * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v)))
      = fun v : ℝ => (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v)) ^ 2 := by funext v; ring
  rw [hsq] at hWW
  have hP := ((hWW.const_mul (8 : ℝ)).sub (hW.const_mul (30 : ℝ))).add_const (15 : ℝ)
  have hA : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => -(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * Real.exp (5 * v / 2))
      (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * (Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * (5 / 2))) u := e5.const_mul _
  have hC := (hA.mul hEX).mul hP
  have hfun : phiTerm' n = fun v : ℝ =>
      -(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * Real.exp (5 * v / 2) *
        Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v))) *
        (8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v)) ^ 2 -
          30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v)) + 15) := rfl
  have heq : phiTerm'' n u =
      (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * (Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * (5 / 2)) *
          Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) +
        -(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) *
          (Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) *
            (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2))))) *
        (8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 -
          30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) + 15) +
      -(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) *
          Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) *
        (8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2) * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) +
              π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2))) -
          30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2))) := by
    unfold phiTerm''; ring
  rw [hfun, heq]
  exact hC

name: XiLab.cast_pow_le_pow_eight
statement:
lemma cast_pow_le_pow_eight (n : ℕ) {i : ℕ} (h1 : 1 ≤ i) (h2 : i ≤ 8) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ i ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 8
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | h
  · rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_pow (by omega : i ≠ 0), zero_pow (by norm_num : (8:ℕ) ≠ 0)]
  · exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by exact_mod_cast h) h2

name: XiLab.summable_deriv2Bound
statement: theorem summable_deriv2Bound (a b : ℝ) : Summable (deriv2Bound a b)
proof:
:=
  (summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one 8 (norm_exp_neg_pi_exp_lt_one a)).mul_left _

name: XiLab.abs_phiTerm''_le
statement:
lemma abs_phiTerm''_le {a b : ℝ} (n : ℕ) {u : ℝ} (hau : a ≤ u) (hub : u ≤ b) :
    |phiTerm'' n u| ≤ deriv2Bound a b n
proof:
:= by
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos

  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) := by positivity
  have hpre0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) *
      Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) := by positivity
  rw [phiTerm'', abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hpre0]
  
  have hP : |16 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 3 -
      112 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 +
      165 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) - 75 / 2| ≤
      16 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 3 +
        112 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 +
        165 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) + 75 / 2 := by
    have hX3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 3 := pow_nonneg hx0 3
    have hX2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · nlinarith [hx0, hX3, hX2]
    · nlinarith [hx0, hX3, hX2]
  
  have hEb : Real.exp (2 * u) ≤ Real.exp (2 * b) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hXb : π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) ≤ π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEb (by positivity)
  have hxb0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b) := by positivity
  have hQ : 16 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 3 +
      112 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 +
      165 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) + 75 / 2 ≤
      16 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 3 +
        112 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 2 +
        165 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) + 75 / 2 := by
    have hc3 : (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 3 ≤
        (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hx0 hXb 3
    have hc2 : (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 ≤
        (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hx0 hXb 2
    linarith
  
  have h5b : Real.exp (5 * u / 2) ≤ Real.exp (5 * b / 2) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hEa : Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) ≤
      Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n := by
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
    have ha' : Real.exp (2 * a) ≤ Real.exp (2 * u) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    have hnn : (n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := cast_le_sq n
    have s1 : (n : ℝ) * (π * Real.exp (2 * a)) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (π * Real.exp (2 * a)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnn (by positivity)
    have s2 : π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * a) ≤ π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha' (by positivity)
    nlinarith [s1, s2]
  have hpre : π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) *
        Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) ≤
      π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * b / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n) := by
    have hpow : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n :=
      pow_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le n
    have hstep : Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) ≤
        Real.exp (5 * b / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n :=
      mul_le_mul h5b hEa (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.exp_pos _).le
    calc π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) *
          Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)))
        = π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * u / 2) *
            Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)))) := by ring
      _ ≤ π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * b / 2) *
            Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep (by positivity)
  calc π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) *
        Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) *
        |16 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 3 -
          112 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 +
          165 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) - 75 / 2|
      ≤ (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * b / 2) *
            Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n)) *
          (16 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 3 +
            112 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 2 +
            165 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) + 75 / 2) := by
        refine mul_le_mul hpre (hP.trans hQ) (abs_nonneg _) ?_
        positivity
    _ ≤ deriv2Bound a b n := by
        have hpow : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n :=
          pow_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le n
        have h2 := cast_pow_le_pow_eight n (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 2) (by norm_num : 2 ≤ 8)
        have h4 := cast_pow_le_pow_eight n (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 4) (by norm_num : 4 ≤ 8)
        have h6 := cast_pow_le_pow_eight n (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 6) (by norm_num : 6 ≤ 8)
        have hE6 : Real.exp (2 * b) ^ 3 = Real.exp (6 * b) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
        have hE4 : Real.exp (2 * b) ^ 2 = Real.exp (4 * b) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
        have hEb0 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp (2 * b) := Real.exp_pos _
        have h5b0 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp (5 * b / 2) := Real.exp_pos _
        rw [deriv2Bound]
        have key : π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 *
              (16 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 3 +
                112 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 2 +
                165 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) + 75 / 2) ≤
            (16 * π ^ 4 * Real.exp (6 * b) + 112 * π ^ 3 * Real.exp (4 * b) +
              165 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b) + 75 / 2 * π) * (n : ℝ) ^ 8 := by
          rw [← hE6, ← hE4]
          have t6 : 112 * π ^ 3 * Real.exp (2 * b) ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 6 ≤
              112 * π ^ 3 * Real.exp (2 * b) ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 8 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h6 (by positivity)
          have t4 : 165 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b) * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤
              165 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b) * (n : ℝ) ^ 8 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 (by positivity)
          have t2 : 75 / 2 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 75 / 2 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 8 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity)
          nlinarith [t6, t4, t2]
        calc (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * b / 2) *
                Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n)) *
              (16 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 3 +
                112 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 2 +
                165 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) + 75 / 2)
            = (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 *
                (16 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 3 +
                  112 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 2 +
                  165 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) + 75 / 2)) *
                (Real.exp (5 * b / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n) := by ring
          _ ≤ ((16 * π ^ 4 * Real.exp (6 * b) + 112 * π ^ 3 * Real.exp (4 * b) +
                165 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b) + 75 / 2 * π) * (n : ℝ) ^ 8) *
                (Real.exp (5 * b / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n) := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right key ?_

          _ = (Real.exp (5 * b / 2) *
                (16 * π ^ 4 * Real.exp (6 * b) + 112 * π ^ 3 * Real.exp (4 * b) +
                  165 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b) + 75 / 2 * π)) *
                ((n : ℝ) ^ 8 * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n) := by ring

proof:

  exact hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected
    (u := fun n : ℕ => deriv2Bound (x - 1) (x + 1) (n + 1))
    (g := fun n : ℕ => phiTerm' (n + 1)) (g' := fun (n : ℕ) (v : ℝ) => phiTerm'' (n + 1) v)

    (fun n y hy => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: XiLab.term_one_bound
proof:
:= by
  have ht1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ X - 3.14 := by linarith
  have ht2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3.19 - X := by linarith
  have hB : 16 * X ^ 3 - 112 * X ^ 2 + 165 * X - 75 / 2 ≤ -100 := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht1 ht2, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht1 ht1) ht2, ht1, ht2,
      sq_nonneg (X - 3.14)]
  have hEX : (1 / 55 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-X) := by
    have h1 : Real.exp (-(4 : ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp (-X) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    linarith [exp_neg_four_ge, h1]
  have hqE : (3.14 : ℝ) * 1 ≤ q * E5 := mul_le_mul hq hE5 (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hA : (3.14 : ℝ) * (1 / 55) ≤ q * E5 * Real.exp (-X) :=
    mul_le_mul (by linarith) hEX (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hApos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q * E5 * Real.exp (-X) := by nlinarith [hA]
  have s1 : q * E5 * Real.exp (-X) * (16 * X ^ 3 - 112 * X ^ 2 + 165 * X - 75 / 2)
      ≤ q * E5 * Real.exp (-X) * (-100) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB hApos
  nlinarith [s1, hA]

name: XiLab.term_two_bound
proof:
:= by
  have hX0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ X := by linarith
  have hB : 16 * X ^ 3 - 112 * X ^ 2 + 165 * X - 75 / 2 ≤ 35100 := by
    have h3 : X ^ 3 ≤ (12.726 : ℝ) ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hX0 hXhi 3
    nlinarith [h3, sq_nonneg X, hXhi]
  have hEX : Real.exp (-X) ≤ 1 / 157000 := by
    have h1 : Real.exp (-X) ≤ Real.exp (-(12 : ℝ)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    linarith [exp_neg_twelve_le, h1]
  have h1 : q * E5 ≤ 12.6 * (101 / 100) := mul_le_mul hq hE5 hE50 (by norm_num)
  have hA : q * E5 * Real.exp (-X) ≤ 12.6 * (101 / 100) * (1 / 157000) :=
    mul_le_mul h1 hEX (Real.exp_pos _).le (by norm_num)
  have hA0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q * E5 * Real.exp (-X) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hq0 hE50) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  calc q * E5 * Real.exp (-X) * (16 * X ^ 3 - 112 * X ^ 2 + 165 * X - 75 / 2)
      ≤ q * E5 * Real.exp (-X) * 35100 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB hA0
    _ ≤ 12.6 * (101 / 100) * (1 / 157000) * 35100 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA (by norm_num)
    _ ≤ 2.9 := by norm_num

name: XiLab.term_tail_bound
proof:
:= by
  have hX0 : (0 : ℝ) < X := by linarith
  have hEX : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp (-X) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hpre0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q * E5 * Real.exp (-X) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hq0 hE50) hEX.le
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hpre0]
  have h28 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (X - 28) * X ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg X)
  have hB : |16 * X ^ 3 - 112 * X ^ 2 + 165 * X - 75 / 2| ≤ 22 * X ^ 3 := by
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · nlinarith [h28, hX0, sq_nonneg X]
    · nlinarith [h28, hX0, sq_nonneg X]
  have hpre : q * E5 * Real.exp (-X) ≤ X * (101 / 100) * Real.exp (-X) := by
    have h1 : q * E5 ≤ X * (101 / 100) := mul_le_mul hqX hE5 hE50 (by linarith)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hEX.le
  have hX4 : X ^ 4 ≤ 4096 * Real.exp (X / 2) := by
    have h1 : X / 8 ≤ Real.exp (X / 8) := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (X / 8)]
    have h2 : (X / 8) ^ 4 ≤ Real.exp (X / 8) ^ 4 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) h1 4
    have h3 : Real.exp (X / 8) ^ 4 = Real.exp (X / 2) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
    rw [h3] at h2
    linarith
  have hEE : Real.exp (X / 2) * Real.exp (-X) = Real.exp (-(X / 2)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  calc q * E5 * Real.exp (-X) * |16 * X ^ 3 - 112 * X ^ 2 + 165 * X - 75 / 2|
      ≤ X * (101 / 100) * Real.exp (-X) * (22 * X ^ 3) := by
        refine mul_le_mul hpre hB (abs_nonneg _) ?_
        exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hX0.le (by norm_num)) hEX.le
    _ = 101 / 100 * 22 * (X ^ 4 * Real.exp (-X)) := by ring
    _ ≤ 101 / 100 * 22 * (4096 * Real.exp (X / 2) * Real.exp (-X)) := by
        have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hX4 hEX.le
        nlinarith [hstep]
    _ = 101 / 100 * 22 * 4096 * Real.exp (-(X / 2)) := by rw [← hEE]; ring
    _ ≤ 94208 * Real.exp (-(X / 2)) := by
        have := (Real.exp_pos (-(X / 2))).le
        nlinarith

name: XiLab.phiTerm''_one_le
statement: lemma phiTerm''_one_le {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1 / 400) : phiTerm'' 1 u ≤ -5.7
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpi1, hpi2⟩ := pi_bounds
  have hE2lo : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (2 * u) := Real.one_le_exp (by linarith)
  have hE2hi : Real.exp (2 * u) ≤ 101 / 100 := exp_le_of_le_inv_160 (by linarith)

  have hc : ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 := by norm_num

  refine term_one_bound (q := π * 1) (E5 := Real.exp (5 * u / 2))

  · nlinarith [hE2hi, hpi2, Real.exp_pos (2 * u)]

name: XiLab.phiTerm''_two_le
statement: lemma phiTerm''_two_le {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1 / 400) : phiTerm'' 2 u ≤ 2.9
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpi1, hpi2⟩ := pi_bounds
  have hE2lo : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (2 * u) := Real.one_le_exp (by linarith)
  have hE2hi : Real.exp (2 * u) ≤ 101 / 100 := exp_le_of_le_inv_160 (by linarith)
  have hE5hi : Real.exp (5 * u / 2) ≤ 101 / 100 := exp_le_of_le_inv_160 (by linarith)
  have hc : ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 = 4 := by norm_num
  rw [phiTerm''_eq, hc]
  refine term_two_bound (q := π * 4) (E5 := Real.exp (5 * u / 2))
    (X := π * 4 * Real.exp (2 * u)) (by positivity) (by linarith) (Real.exp_pos _).le hE5hi
    ?_ ?_
  · nlinarith [hE2lo, hpi1]
  · nlinarith [hE2hi, hpi2, Real.exp_pos (2 * u)]

name: XiLab.phiTerm''_tail_le
statement:
lemma phiTerm''_tail_le {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1 / 400) {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) :
    |phiTerm'' m u| ≤ 94208 * Real.exp (-4) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpi1, hpi2⟩ := pi_bounds
  have hE2lo : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (2 * u) := Real.one_le_exp (by linarith)
  have hE5hi : Real.exp (5 * u / 2) ≤ 101 / 100 := exp_le_of_le_inv_160 (by linarith)
  have hm3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ π * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hmm : 3 * (m : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hqX : π * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ π * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) := by
    nlinarith [hq0, hE2lo]
  have hs1 : (3.14 : ℝ) * (3 * (m : ℝ)) ≤ π * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hmm, hpi1, hm3, sq_nonneg ((m : ℝ))]
  have hX28 : (28 : ℝ) ≤ π * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) := by
    nlinarith [hs1, hqX, hm3]
  rw [phiTerm''_eq]
  refine (term_tail_bound hq0 hqX hX28 (Real.exp_pos _).le hE5hi).trans ?_
  have hfin : Real.exp (-(π * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) / 2)) ≤ Real.exp (-4) ^ m := by
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
    have h1 : (8 : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) ≤ π * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) := by
      nlinarith [hs1, hqX, hm3]
    linarith
  linarith [hfin]

name: XiLab.tail_tsum_le
statement:
theorem tail_tsum_le {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1 / 400) :
    |∑' n : ℕ, phiTerm'' (n + 3) u| ≤ 1.2
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-4) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hrle : Real.exp (-4) ≤ 1 / 54 := exp_neg_four_le
  have hr1 : Real.exp (-4) < 1 := by linarith
  have hgeo : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (-4) ^ n) (1 - Real.exp (-4))⁻¹ :=
    hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one hr0 hr1
  have hg : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 94208 * Real.exp (-4) ^ 3 * Real.exp (-4) ^ n)
      (94208 * Real.exp (-4) ^ 3 * (1 - Real.exp (-4))⁻¹) := hgeo.mul_left _
  have hbd : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖phiTerm'' (n + 3) u‖ ≤ 94208 * Real.exp (-4) ^ 3 * Real.exp (-4) ^ n := by
    intro n
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have := phiTerm''_tail_le hu0 hu1 (m := n + 3) (by omega)
    calc |phiTerm'' (n + 3) u| ≤ 94208 * Real.exp (-4) ^ (n + 3) := this
      _ = 94208 * Real.exp (-4) ^ 3 * Real.exp (-4) ^ n := by rw [pow_add]; ring
  have hmain := tsum_of_norm_bounded hg hbd
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmain
  refine hmain.trans ?_
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - Real.exp (-4) := by linarith
  have hinvpos : (0 : ℝ) < (1 - Real.exp (-4))⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hpos
  have hinv2 : (1 - Real.exp (-4))⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
    have hlow : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ 1 - Real.exp (-4) := by linarith
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow hinvpos.le
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne'] at h
    linarith
  have hr3 : Real.exp (-4) ^ 3 ≤ (1 / 54 : ℝ) ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hr0 hrle 3
  have hstep : Real.exp (-4) ^ 3 * (1 - Real.exp (-4))⁻¹ ≤ (1 / 54 : ℝ) ^ 3 * 2 :=
    mul_le_mul hr3 hinv2 hinvpos.le (by norm_num)
  nlinarith [hstep]

name: XiLab.norm_le_linear_of_re_le_linear
proof:
:= by
  have ht : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ := norm_nonneg z
  have hL : (0 : ℝ) ≤ |L| := abs_nonneg L
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖g 0‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hR : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ‖z‖ + 2 := by linarith
  have hM : (0 : ℝ) < |L| + B * (2 * ‖z‖ + 2) + 1 := by
    have : 0 ≤ B * (2 * ‖z‖ + 2) := mul_nonneg hB hR.le
    linarith
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo g (ball 0 (2 * ‖z‖ + 2))
      {w : ℂ | w.re ≤ |L| + B * (2 * ‖z‖ + 2) + 1} := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : ‖x‖ < 2 * ‖z‖ + 2 := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hx
    have h1 : (g x).re ≤ L + B * ‖x‖ := hre x
    have h2 : B * ‖x‖ ≤ B * (2 * ‖z‖ + 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx'.le hB
    have h3 : L ≤ |L| := le_abs_self L
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    linarith
  have hz : z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * ‖z‖ + 2) := by
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]; linarith
  have hbc := Complex.borelCaratheodory hM hg.differentiableOn hmaps hR hz
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ‖z‖ + 2 - ‖z‖ := by linarith
  refine hbc.trans ?_
  rw [← add_div, div_le_iff₀ hden]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hB ht, mul_nonneg h0 ht, mul_nonneg hL ht]

name: XiLab.norm_deriv_le_of_linear_growth
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_forall_gt_imp_ge_of_dense fun c hc => ?_
  set ε : ℝ := c - b with hε_def
  have hε : 0 < ε := by simp only [hε_def]; linarith
  have hnum : (0 : ℝ) ≤ a + b * ‖w‖ := add_nonneg ha (mul_nonneg hb (norm_nonneg w))
  set R : ℝ := (a + b * ‖w‖) / ε + 1 with hR_def
  have hR : 0 < R := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (a + b * ‖w‖) / ε := div_nonneg hnum hε.le
    simp only [hR_def]; linarith
  have hC : ∀ x ∈ sphere w R, ‖g x‖ ≤ a + b * (‖w‖ + R) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxw : ‖x - w‖ = R := mem_sphere_iff_norm.1 hx
    have hxn : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖w‖ + R := by
      have := norm_add_le (x - w) w
      rw [hxw] at this
      simpa [sub_add_cancel] using this.trans_eq (by ring)
    calc ‖g x‖ ≤ a + b * ‖x‖ := hgrow x
      _ ≤ a + b * (‖w‖ + R) := by gcongr
  have hd := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hR hg.diffContOnCl hC
  refine hd.trans ?_
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hR]
  have hkey : ε * R = (a + b * ‖w‖) + ε := by
    simp only [hR_def]
    field_simp
  have hcε : c = b + ε := by simp only [hε_def]; ring
  rw [hcε]
  nlinarith [hkey]

name: XiLab.eq_affine_of_linear_growth
proof:
:= by
  have hdd : Differentiable ℂ (deriv g) := hg.deriv
  have hbdd : IsBounded (Set.range (deriv g)) := by
    rw [isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le]
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact norm_deriv_le_of_linear_growth hg ha hb hgrow w
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hdd.exists_const_forall_eq_of_bounded hbdd
  refine ⟨c, fun z => ?_⟩
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℂ fun t : ℂ => g t - c * t := by fun_prop
  have hzero : ∀ x : ℂ, deriv (fun t : ℂ => g t - c * t) x = 0 := by
    intro x
    have h1 : HasDerivAt g (deriv g x) x := (hg x).hasDerivAt
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℂ => c * t) c x := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul c
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℂ => g t - c * t) (deriv g x - c) x := h1.sub h2
    rw [h3.deriv, hc x]
    ring
  have h := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hdiff hzero z 0
  simp only [mul_zero, sub_zero] at h
  linear_combination h

name: XiLab.eq_exp_affine_of_order_le_one
statement:
theorem eq_exp_affine_of_order_le_one {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hnz : ∀ z, f z ≠ 0) {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    (hgrowth : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖f z‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖)) :
    ∃ a b : ℂ, ∀ z, f z = Complex.exp (a * z + b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hfg⟩ := exists_entire_log hf hnz
  
  set B' : ℝ := max B 0 with hB'_def
  have hB' : 0 ≤ B' := le_max_right _ _
  have hgrowth' : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖f z‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (B' * ‖z‖) := by
    intro z
    refine (hgrowth z).trans ?_
    have hmul : B * ‖z‖ ≤ B' * ‖z‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (norm_nonneg z)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hmul) hA.le
  
  have hre : ∀ z : ℂ, (g z).re ≤ Real.log A + B' * ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    have h1 : Real.exp ((g z).re) ≤ A * Real.exp (B' * ‖z‖) := by
      have h := hgrowth' z
      rwa [hfg z, Complex.norm_exp] at h
    have h2 : A * Real.exp (B' * ‖z‖) = Real.exp (Real.log A + B' * ‖z‖) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hA]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mp h1
  
  have hlin : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖g z‖ ≤
      (2 * |Real.log A| + 4 * B' + 2 + 3 * ‖g 0‖) + 4 * B' * ‖z‖ :=
    fun z => norm_le_linear_of_re_le_linear hg hB' hre z
  have ha : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * |Real.log A| + 4 * B' + 2 + 3 * ‖g 0‖ := by
    have := abs_nonneg (Real.log A)
    have := norm_nonneg (g 0)
    linarith
  have hb : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * B' := by linarith
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := eq_affine_of_linear_growth hg ha hb hlin
  exact ⟨c, g 0, fun z => by rw [hfg z, hc z]⟩

name: XiLab.exists_entire_div_of_zero
statement:
theorem exists_entire_div_of_zero {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) {A B : ℝ}
    (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hgrowth : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖f z‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖))
    {z₀ : ℂ} (hz₀ : f z₀ = 0) :
    ∃ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (A' : ℝ), Differentiable ℂ g ∧ 0 < A' ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, ‖g z‖ ≤ A' * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖)) ∧ (∀ z, f z = (z - z₀) * g z)
proof:
:= by
  have hgd : Differentiable ℂ (dslope f z₀) := by
    rw [← differentiableOn_univ]
    exact (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (by simp)).mpr (differentiableOn_univ.mpr hf)
  have hfac : ∀ z, f z = (z - z₀) * dslope f z₀ z := by
    intro z
    have h := sub_smul_dslope f z₀ z
    rw [hz₀, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at h
    exact h.symm
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall z₀ 1).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    hgd.continuous.continuousOn
  refine ⟨dslope f z₀, max A (max C 1), hgd, lt_max_of_lt_left hA, fun z => ?_, hfac⟩
  have hexp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (B * ‖z‖) :=
    Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg hB (norm_nonneg z))
  have hAle : A ≤ max A (max C 1) := le_max_left _ _
  have hCle : C ≤ max A (max C 1) := (le_max_left C 1).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < max A (max C 1) := lt_max_of_lt_left hA
  rcases le_or_gt 1 ‖z - z₀‖ with h | h
  · have hnorm : ‖z - z₀‖ * ‖dslope f z₀ z‖ = ‖f z‖ := by
      rw [hfac z, norm_mul]
    have hle : ‖dslope f z₀ z‖ ≤ ‖f z‖ := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (dslope f z₀ z)]
    calc ‖dslope f z₀ z‖ ≤ ‖f z‖ := hle
      _ ≤ A * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖) := hgrowth z
      _ ≤ max A (max C 1) * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖) := by gcongr
  · have hmem : z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ 1 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      exact h.le
    calc ‖dslope f z₀ z‖ ≤ C := hC z hmem
      _ ≤ max A (max C 1) := hCle
      _ = max A (max C 1) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ ≤ max A (max C 1) * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖) := by gcongr

name: XiLab.exists_pow_mul_of_order_le
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mul_of_order_le {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (z₀ : ℂ) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (A : ℝ), Differentiable ℂ f → 0 < A →
      (∀ z : ℂ, ‖f z‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖)) →
      analyticOrderAt f z₀ ≤ (m : ℕ∞) →
      ∃ (j : ℕ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (A' : ℝ), Differentiable ℂ g ∧ 0 < A' ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, ‖g z‖ ≤ A' * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖)) ∧ g z₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ z, f z = (z - z₀) ^ j * g z)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro f A hf hA hgrow hord
    have h0 : analyticOrderAt f z₀ = 0 := le_antisymm (by simpa using hord) (by simp)
    exact ⟨0, f, A, hf, hA, hgrow, (hf.analyticAt z₀).analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.mp h0, by simp⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    intro f A hf hA hgrow hord
    by_cases hz₀ : f z₀ = 0
    · obtain ⟨h, A', hh, hA', hhgrow, hfac⟩ := exists_entire_div_of_zero hf hA hB hgrow hz₀
      have hprod : f = (fun z : ℂ => z - z₀) * h := funext fun z => by simpa using hfac z
      have hmono : analyticOrderAt (fun z : ℂ => z - z₀) z₀ = 1 := by
        simpa using analyticOrderAt_centeredMonomial (𝕜 := ℂ) (z₀ := z₀) (n := 1)
      have hsum : analyticOrderAt f z₀ = 1 + analyticOrderAt h z₀ := by
        rw [hprod, analyticOrderAt_mul (by fun_prop) (hh.analyticAt z₀), hmono]
      have hordh : analyticOrderAt h z₀ ≤ (m : ℕ∞) := by
        refine (ENat.add_le_add_iff_left (k := 1) (by simp)).mp ?_
        rw [← hsum]
        refine hord.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
        push_cast
        ring
      obtain ⟨j, g, A'', hg, hA'', hggrow, hgz, hgfac⟩ := ih h A' hh hA' hhgrow hordh
      refine ⟨j + 1, g, A'', hg, hA'', hggrow, hgz, fun z => ?_⟩
      rw [hfac z, hgfac z]
      ring
    · exact ⟨0, f, A, hf, hA, hgrow, hz₀, by simp⟩

name: XiLab.exists_poly_mul_exp_aux
statement:
theorem exists_poly_mul_exp_aux {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (A : ℝ), Differentiable ℂ f → 0 < A →
      (∀ z : ℂ, ‖f z‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖)) →
      {z : ℂ | f z = 0}.Finite → {z : ℂ | f z = 0}.ncard = k →
      ∃ (P : Polynomial ℂ) (a b : ℂ), ∀ z, f z = P.eval z * Complex.exp (a * z + b)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro f A hf hA hgrow hfin hcard
    have hempty : {z : ℂ | f z = 0} = ∅ := (Set.ncard_eq_zero hfin).mp hcard
    have hnz : ∀ z, f z ≠ 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have : z ∈ ({z : ℂ | f z = 0}) := hz
      rw [hempty] at this
      exact this
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := eq_exp_affine_of_order_le_one hf hnz hA hgrow
    exact ⟨1, a, b, fun z => by rw [hab z]; simp⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro f A hf hA hgrow hfin hcard
    have hne : {z : ℂ | f z = 0}.Nonempty := by
      rw [Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
      intro hc
      rw [hc] at hcard
      simp at hcard
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := hne
    have hfne : ¬ (f = 0) := by
      rintro rfl
      have huniv : {z : ℂ | (0 : ℂ → ℂ) z = 0} = Set.univ := by ext; simp
      rw [huniv] at hfin
      exact Set.infinite_univ hfin
    have hordne : analyticOrderAt f z₀ ≠ ⊤ := by
      rw [ne_eq, AnalyticOnNhd.analyticOrderAt_eq_top_iff_eq_zero z₀ fun w => hf.analyticAt w]
      exact hfne
    have hle : analyticOrderAt f z₀ ≤ (((analyticOrderAt f z₀).toNat : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
      le_of_eq (ENat.coe_toNat hordne).symm
    obtain ⟨j, g, A', hg, hA', hggrow, hgz, hgfac⟩ :=
      exists_pow_mul_of_order_le hB z₀ _ f A hf hA hgrow hle
    have hzero : {z : ℂ | g z = 0} = {z : ℂ | f z = 0} \ {z₀} := by
      ext w
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      constructor
      · intro hw
        refine ⟨by rw [hgfac w, hw, mul_zero], ?_⟩
        rintro rfl
        exact hgz hw
      · rintro ⟨hw, hnew⟩
        have hz := hgfac w
        rw [hw] at hz
        have hpow : (w - z₀) ^ j ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (sub_ne_zero_of_ne hnew)
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz.symm).resolve_left hpow
    have hfin' : {z : ℂ | g z = 0}.Finite := by
      rw [hzero]; exact hfin.sdiff
    have hcard' : {z : ℂ | g z = 0}.ncard = k := by
      have h1 : ({z : ℂ | f z = 0} \ {z₀}).ncard + 1 = {z : ℂ | f z = 0}.ncard :=
        Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one hz₀ hfin
      rw [hcard] at h1
      rw [hzero]
      omega
    obtain ⟨Q, a, b, hQ⟩ := ih g A' hg hA' hggrow hfin' hcard'
    refine ⟨(Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C z₀) ^ j * Q, a, b, fun z => ?_⟩
    rw [hgfac z, hQ z]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_sub,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
    ring

name: XiLab.exists_poly_mul_exp_of_finite_zeros
statement:
theorem exists_poly_mul_exp_of_finite_zeros {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) {A B : ℝ}
    (hA : 0 < A) (hgrowth : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖f z‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖))
    (hfin : {z : ℂ | f z = 0}.Finite) :
    ∃ (P : Polynomial ℂ) (a b : ℂ), ∀ z, f z = P.eval z * Complex.exp (a * z + b)
proof:
:= by
  have hB : (0 : ℝ) ≤ max B 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hgrowth' : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖f z‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (max B 0 * ‖z‖) := by
    intro z
    refine (hgrowth z).trans ?_
    have hmul : B * ‖z‖ ≤ max B 0 * ‖z‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (norm_nonneg z)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hmul) hA.le
  exact exists_poly_mul_exp_aux hB _ f A hf hA hgrowth' hfin rfl

name: XiLab.exists_zero_of_not_eq_exp_affine
statement:
theorem exists_zero_of_not_eq_exp_affine {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) {A B : ℝ}
    (hA : 0 < A) (hgrowth : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖f z‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖))
    (hne : ¬ ∃ a b : ℂ, ∀ z, f z = Complex.exp (a * z + b)) :
    ∃ z, f z = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  exact hne (eq_exp_affine_of_order_le_one hf (fun z hz => hc ⟨z, hz⟩) hA hgrowth)

name: XiLab.self_div_add_one_le_log_add_one
statement:
theorem self_div_add_one_le_log_add_one {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    u / (1 + u) ≤ Real.log (1 + u)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + u := by linarith
  have h2 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (x := 1 / (1 + u)) (by positivity)
  rw [Real.log_div one_ne_zero h1.ne', Real.log_one, zero_sub] at h2
  have h3 : 1 / (1 + u) - 1 = -(u / (1 + u)) := by field_simp; ring
  rw [h3] at h2
  linarith

name: XiLab.le_mul_log_sub_log
statement:
theorem le_mul_log_sub_log {a t : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    t ≤ (a + t) * (Real.log (a + t) - Real.log a)
proof:
:= by
  have hat : (0 : ℝ) < a + t := by linarith
  have key : t / (a + t) ≤ Real.log (a + t) - Real.log a := by
    have h := self_div_add_one_le_log_add_one (u := t / a) (by positivity)
    have e1 : 1 + t / a = (a + t) / a := by field_simp
    rw [e1, Real.log_div hat.ne' ha.ne'] at h
    have e2 : t / a / ((a + t) / a) = t / (a + t) := by
      field_simp
    rwa [e2] at h
  calc t = (a + t) * (t / (a + t)) := by field_simp
    _ ≤ (a + t) * (Real.log (a + t) - Real.log a) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key hat.le

name: XiLab.log_Gamma_natCast_add_one_le
statement:
theorem log_Gamma_natCast_add_one_le (n : ℕ) :
    Real.log (Real.Gamma ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - (n + 1) + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ m ih =>
    have hm : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hpos : 0 < Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) + 1) := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos hm
    have hlog : Real.log (Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) + 1 + 1))
        = Real.log ((m : ℝ) + 1) + Real.log (Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      rw [Real.Gamma_add_one hm.ne', Real.log_mul hm.ne' hpos.ne']
    have hgap := le_mul_log_sub_log (a := (m : ℝ) + 1) (t := 1) hm zero_le_one
    push_cast
    rw [hlog]
    linarith

name: XiLab.log_Gamma_natCast_le
statement:
theorem log_Gamma_natCast_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Real.log (Real.Gamma (n : ℝ)) ≤ (n : ℝ) * Real.log (n : ℝ) - n + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  have := log_Gamma_natCast_add_one_le m
  push_cast
  exact this

name: XiLab.log_Gamma_le
statement:
theorem log_Gamma_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    Real.log (Real.Gamma x) ≤ x * Real.log x - x + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn1, hnx, hxn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ x ∧ x < (n : ℝ) + 1 :=
    ⟨⌊x⌋₊, (Nat.one_le_floor_iff x).2 hx, Nat.floor_le hx0.le, Nat.lt_floor_add_one x⟩
  have hnR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn1
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by linarith
  
  have ha : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - (x - (n : ℝ)) := by linarith
  have hb : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x - (n : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hab : (1 - (x - (n : ℝ))) + (x - (n : ℝ)) = 1 := by ring
  have hconv := Real.convexOn_log_Gamma.2 (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr hn0)
      (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1)) ha hb hab
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hconv
  have harg : (1 - (x - (n : ℝ))) * (n : ℝ) + (x - (n : ℝ)) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) = x := by ring
  rw [harg] at hconv
  
  have hgpos : 0 < Real.Gamma (n : ℝ) := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos hn0
  have hGn : Real.log (Real.Gamma ((n : ℝ) + 1))
      = Real.log (n : ℝ) + Real.log (Real.Gamma (n : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Real.Gamma_add_one hn0.ne', Real.log_mul hn0.ne' hgpos.ne']
  rw [hGn] at hconv
  
  have hint := log_Gamma_natCast_le hn1
  have hgap := le_mul_log_sub_log hn0 hb
  have hsum : (n : ℝ) + (x - (n : ℝ)) = x := by ring
  rw [hsum] at hgap
  nlinarith [hconv, hint, hgap]

name: XiLab.Gamma_le
statement:
theorem Gamma_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    Real.Gamma x ≤ Real.exp 1 * x ^ x * Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := by linarith
  have hg : 0 < Real.Gamma x := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos hx0
  calc Real.Gamma x = Real.exp (Real.log (Real.Gamma x)) := (Real.exp_log hg).symm
    _ ≤ Real.exp (x * Real.log x - x + 1) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (log_Gamma_le hx)
    _ = Real.exp 1 * x ^ x * Real.exp (-x) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hx0, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring

name: XiLab.log_Gamma_le_mul_log
statement:
theorem log_Gamma_le_mul_log {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    Real.log (Real.Gamma x) ≤ x * Real.log x
proof:
:= by
  have := log_Gamma_le hx
  linarith

name: XiLab.Gamma_le_exp_mul_log
statement:
theorem Gamma_le_exp_mul_log {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    Real.Gamma x ≤ Real.exp (x * Real.log x)
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := by linarith
  have hg : 0 < Real.Gamma x := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos hx0
  calc Real.Gamma x = Real.exp (Real.log (Real.Gamma x)) := (Real.exp_log hg).symm
    _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (log_Gamma_le_mul_log hx)

name: XiLab.log_Gamma_le_rpow
statement:
theorem log_Gamma_le_rpow {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    Real.log (Real.Gamma x) ≤ x ^ (1 + ε) / ε
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := by linarith
  have hlog : Real.log x ≤ x ^ ε / ε := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 ε)
    rw [Real.log_rpow hx0] at h
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hε]
    nlinarith [h]
  have hxr : x ^ (1 + ε) = x * x ^ ε := by rw [Real.rpow_add hx0, Real.rpow_one]
  refine le_trans (log_Gamma_le_mul_log hx) ?_
  rw [hxr]
  calc x * Real.log x ≤ x * (x ^ ε / ε) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hx0.le
    _ = x * x ^ ε / ε := by ring

name: XiLab.Gamma_le_exp_rpow
statement:
theorem Gamma_le_exp_rpow {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    Real.Gamma x ≤ Real.exp (x ^ (1 + ε) / ε)
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := by linarith
  have hg : 0 < Real.Gamma x := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos hx0
  calc Real.Gamma x = Real.exp (Real.log (Real.Gamma x)) := (Real.exp_log hg).symm
    _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (log_Gamma_le_rpow hε hx)

name: XiLab.log_Gamma_le_of_pos
statement:
theorem log_Gamma_le_of_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    Real.log (Real.Gamma x) ≤ (x + 1) * Real.log (x + 1) - x - Real.log x
proof:
:= by
  have h := log_Gamma_le (x := x + 1) (by linarith)
  have hg : 0 < Real.Gamma x := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos hx
  have hsplit : Real.log (Real.Gamma (x + 1)) = Real.log x + Real.log (Real.Gamma x) := by
    rw [Real.Gamma_add_one hx.ne', Real.log_mul hx.ne' hg.ne']
  rw [hsplit] at h
  linarith

name: XiLab.log_Gamma_shift_le

name: XiLab.log_Gamma_shift_le_rpow

theorem log_Gamma_shift_le_rpow {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :

name: XiLab.one_le_sqrt_one_add
statement: theorem one_le_sqrt_one_add {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + r)

name: XiLab.one_le_phi32
statement: theorem one_le_phi32 {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) : 1 ≤ phi32 r
proof:
:= by

name: XiLab.phi32_nonneg
statement: theorem phi32_nonneg {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) : 0 ≤ phi32 r

name: XiLab.phi32_mono
statement: theorem phi32_mono {r s : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (h : r ≤ s) : phi32 r ≤ phi32 s
proof:
:= by

name: XiLab.sqrt_three_le_two
statement: theorem sqrt_three_le_two : Real.sqrt 3 ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 3 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 3]

name: XiLab.sqrt_two_le
statement: theorem sqrt_two_le : Real.sqrt 2 ≤ 3 / 2

  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]

name: XiLab.phi32_le_six_mul
statement:
theorem phi32_le_six_mul {x r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (h : 1 + x ≤ 3 * (1 + r)) :
    phi32 x ≤ 6 * phi32 r
proof:
:= by
  have hr1 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + r := by linarith
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (1 + x) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (1 + r) := by
    calc Real.sqrt (1 + x) ≤ Real.sqrt (3 * (1 + r)) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h
      _ = Real.sqrt 3 * Real.sqrt (1 + r) := Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num) _
      _ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (1 + r) := by
          have := Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + r)
          nlinarith [sqrt_three_le_two]
  have hxn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + x) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  unfold phi32
  nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + r)]

name: XiLab.rpow_three_halves_le_phi32
statement: theorem rpow_three_halves_le_phi32 {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) : r ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) ≤ phi32 r
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + r := by linarith
  have h2 : r ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) ≤ (1 + r) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow hr (by linarith) (by norm_num)
  refine h2.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  have h3 : ((3 : ℝ) / 2) = 1 + 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  rw [h3, Real.rpow_add h1, Real.rpow_one, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  rfl

name: XiLab.norm_le_phi32_of_re_le_phi32
proof:
:= by
  have ht : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ := norm_nonneg z
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ phi32 ‖z‖ := one_le_phi32 ht
  have hL : (0 : ℝ) ≤ |L| := abs_nonneg L
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖g 0‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hR : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ‖z‖ + 2 := by linarith
  have hMpos : (0 : ℝ) < |L| + 6 * B * phi32 ‖z‖ + 1 := by nlinarith
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo g (ball 0 (2 * ‖z‖ + 2))
      {w : ℂ | w.re ≤ |L| + 6 * B * phi32 ‖z‖ + 1} := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : ‖x‖ < 2 * ‖z‖ + 2 := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hx
    have hle : phi32 ‖x‖ ≤ 6 * phi32 ‖z‖ := phi32_le_six_mul ht (by linarith)
    have h1 : (g x).re ≤ L + B * phi32 ‖x‖ := hre x
    have h2 : B * phi32 ‖x‖ ≤ B * (6 * phi32 ‖z‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle hB
    have h3 : L ≤ |L| := le_abs_self L
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    linarith
  have hz : z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * ‖z‖ + 2) := by rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]; linarith
  have hbc := Complex.borelCaratheodory hMpos hg.differentiableOn hmaps hR hz
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ‖z‖ + 2 - ‖z‖ := by linarith
  have hbc' : ‖g z‖ ≤ 2 * (|L| + 6 * B * phi32 ‖z‖ + 1) + 3 * ‖g 0‖ := by
    refine hbc.trans ?_
    rw [← add_div, div_le_iff₀ hden]
    nlinarith [hMpos.le, ht, h0]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hL (sub_nonneg.mpr hp1), mul_nonneg h0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hp1)]

name: XiLab.norm_deriv_le_sqrt_of_phi32_growth
proof:
:= by
  have hw : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖w‖ := norm_nonneg w
  have hR : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + ‖w‖ := by linarith
  have hC : ∀ x ∈ sphere w (1 + ‖w‖), ‖g x‖ ≤ K * (6 * phi32 ‖w‖) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxw : ‖x - w‖ = 1 + ‖w‖ := mem_sphere_iff_norm.1 hx
    have hxn : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖w‖ + (1 + ‖w‖) := by
      have h := norm_add_le (x - w) w
      rw [hxw] at h
      simpa [sub_add_cancel] using h.trans_eq (by ring)
    have hle : phi32 ‖x‖ ≤ 6 * phi32 ‖w‖ := phi32_le_six_mul hw (by linarith)
    calc ‖g x‖ ≤ K * phi32 ‖x‖ := hgrow x
      _ ≤ K * (6 * phi32 ‖w‖) := by gcongr
  have hd := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hR hg.diffContOnCl hC
  refine hd.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hR)]
  unfold phi32
  ring

name: XiLab.deriv_deriv_eq_zero_of_sqrt_growth
proof:
:= by
  rw [← norm_le_zero_iff]
  refine le_of_forall_gt_imp_ge_of_dense fun δ hδ => ?_
  have hw : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖w‖ := norm_nonneg w
  set R : ℝ := max (1 + ‖w‖) ((3 * K / (2 * δ)) ^ 2 + 1) with hR_def
  have hR1 : 1 + ‖w‖ ≤ R := le_max_left _ _
  have hR2 : (3 * K / (2 * δ)) ^ 2 + 1 ≤ R := le_max_right _ _
  have hR : (0 : ℝ) < R := by linarith
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt R := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hR
  have hδ' : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * δ := by linarith
  have hkey : 3 * K / (2 * δ) ≤ Real.sqrt R := by
    have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * K / (2 * δ) := by positivity
    exact (Real.le_sqrt hnn hR.le).mpr (by linarith)
  have hkey2 : 3 * K ≤ 2 * δ * Real.sqrt R := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hδ'] at hkey
    linarith
  have hC : ∀ x ∈ sphere w R, ‖deriv g x‖ ≤ K * (3 / 2 * Real.sqrt R) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxw : ‖x - w‖ = R := mem_sphere_iff_norm.1 hx
    have hxn : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖w‖ + R := by
      have h := norm_add_le (x - w) w
      rw [hxw] at h
      simpa [sub_add_cancel] using h.trans_eq (by ring)
    have h1 : 1 + ‖x‖ ≤ 2 * R := by linarith
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (1 + ‖x‖) ≤ 3 / 2 * Real.sqrt R := by
      calc Real.sqrt (1 + ‖x‖) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * R) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
        _ = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt R := Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num) _
        _ ≤ 3 / 2 * Real.sqrt R := by nlinarith [sqrt_two_le, hsR.le]
    calc ‖deriv g x‖ ≤ K * Real.sqrt (1 + ‖x‖) := hgrow x
      _ ≤ K * (3 / 2 * Real.sqrt R) := by gcongr
  have hd := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hR hg.deriv.diffContOnCl hC
  refine hd.trans ?_
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hR]
  have h5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkey2 hsR.le
  have h6 : 2 * δ * Real.sqrt R * Real.sqrt R = 2 * δ * R := by
    rw [mul_assoc, Real.mul_self_sqrt hR.le]
  linarith

name: XiLab.eq_affine_of_deriv_deriv_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_affine_of_deriv_deriv_eq_zero {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : Differentiable ℂ g)
    (h : ∀ w, deriv (deriv g) w = 0) : ∃ c : ℂ, ∀ z, g z = c * z + g 0
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : ∀ x, deriv g x = deriv g 0 := fun x => is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hg.deriv h x 0
  refine ⟨deriv g 0, fun z => ?_⟩
  set c : ℂ := deriv g 0 with hc_def
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℂ fun t : ℂ => g t - c * t := by fun_prop
  have hzero : ∀ x : ℂ, deriv (fun t : ℂ => g t - c * t) x = 0 := by
    intro x
    have h1 : HasDerivAt g (deriv g x) x := (hg x).hasDerivAt
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℂ => c * t) c x := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul c
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℂ => g t - c * t) (deriv g x - c) x := h1.sub h2
    rw [h3.deriv, hconst x]
    ring
  have hh := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hdiff hzero z 0
  simp only [mul_zero, sub_zero] at hh
  linear_combination hh

name: XiLab.eq_exp_affine_of_hasOrderLeOne
statement:
theorem eq_exp_affine_of_hasOrderLeOne {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hnz : ∀ z, f z ≠ 0) (hord : HasOrderLeOne f) :
    ∃ a b : ℂ, ∀ z, f z = Complex.exp (a * z + b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hfg⟩ := exists_entire_log hf hnz
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hCz⟩ := hord (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  have hre : ∀ z : ℂ, (g z).re ≤ Real.log C + C * phi32 ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    have hz : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ := norm_nonneg z
    have h1 : ‖f z‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (C * ‖z‖ ^ (1 + 1 / 2 : ℝ)) := hCz z
    have hexp : ‖z‖ ^ (1 + 1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ phi32 ‖z‖ := by
      have he : ((1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) = 3 / 2 := by norm_num
      rw [he]
      exact rpow_three_halves_le_phi32 hz
    have h2 : Real.exp ((g z).re) ≤ C * Real.exp (C * ‖z‖ ^ (1 + 1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [hfg z, Complex.norm_exp] at h1
      exact h1
    have h3 : C * Real.exp (C * ‖z‖ ^ (1 + 1 / 2 : ℝ))
        ≤ Real.exp (Real.log C + C * phi32 ‖z‖) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hC]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp hC.le)) hC.le
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mp (h2.trans h3)
  have hK : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * |Real.log C| + 12 * C + 2 + 3 * ‖g 0‖ := by positivity
  have hgrow := norm_le_phi32_of_re_le_phi32 hg hC.le hre
  have hd1 := norm_deriv_le_sqrt_of_phi32_growth hg hK hgrow
  have hd2 := deriv_deriv_eq_zero_of_sqrt_growth hg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 6 * (2 * |Real.log C|
    + 12 * C + 2 + 3 * ‖g 0‖)) hd1
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := eq_affine_of_deriv_deriv_eq_zero hg hd2
  exact ⟨c, g 0, fun z => by rw [hfg z, hc z]⟩

name: XiLab.exists_entire_div_of_zero_gen
statement:
theorem exists_entire_div_of_zero_gen {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hord : HasOrderLeOne f) {z₀ : ℂ} (hz₀ : f z₀ = 0) :
    ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, Differentiable ℂ g ∧ HasOrderLeOne g ∧ (∀ z, f z = (z - z₀) * g z)
proof:
:= by
  have hgd : Differentiable ℂ (dslope f z₀) := by
    rw [← differentiableOn_univ]
    exact (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (by simp)).mpr (differentiableOn_univ.mpr hf)
  have hfac : ∀ z, f z = (z - z₀) * dslope f z₀ z := by
    intro z
    have h := sub_smul_dslope f z₀ z
    rw [hz₀, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at h
    exact h.symm
  refine ⟨dslope f z₀, hgd, ?_, hfac⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hCz⟩ := hord ε hε
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall z₀ 1).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    hgd.continuous.continuousOn
  refine ⟨max C (max C₀ 1), lt_max_of_lt_left hC, fun z => ?_⟩
  have hrp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ ^ (1 + ε) := Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg z) _
  have hCle : C ≤ max C (max C₀ 1) := le_max_left _ _
  have hC₀le : C₀ ≤ max C (max C₀ 1) := (le_max_left C₀ 1).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < max C (max C₀ 1) := lt_max_of_lt_left hC
  have hexp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (max C (max C₀ 1) * ‖z‖ ^ (1 + ε)) :=
    Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg hpos.le hrp)
  rcases le_or_gt 1 ‖z - z₀‖ with h | h
  · have hnorm : ‖z - z₀‖ * ‖dslope f z₀ z‖ = ‖f z‖ := by rw [hfac z, norm_mul]
    have hle : ‖dslope f z₀ z‖ ≤ ‖f z‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (dslope f z₀ z)]
    calc ‖dslope f z₀ z‖ ≤ ‖f z‖ := hle
      _ ≤ C * Real.exp (C * ‖z‖ ^ (1 + ε)) := hCz z
      _ ≤ max C (max C₀ 1) * Real.exp (max C (max C₀ 1) * ‖z‖ ^ (1 + ε)) := by gcongr
  · have hmem : z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ 1 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      exact h.le
    calc ‖dslope f z₀ z‖ ≤ C₀ := hC₀ z hmem
      _ ≤ max C (max C₀ 1) := hC₀le
      _ = max C (max C₀ 1) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ ≤ max C (max C₀ 1) * Real.exp (max C (max C₀ 1) * ‖z‖ ^ (1 + ε)) := by gcongr

name: XiLab.exists_pow_mul_of_hasOrderLeOne
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mul_of_hasOrderLeOne (z₀ : ℂ) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → HasOrderLeOne f →
      analyticOrderAt f z₀ ≤ (m : ℕ∞) →
      ∃ (j : ℕ) (g : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ g ∧ HasOrderLeOne g ∧ g z₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ z, f z = (z - z₀) ^ j * g z)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro f hf hord hordle
    have h0 : analyticOrderAt f z₀ = 0 := le_antisymm (by simpa using hordle) (by simp)
    exact ⟨0, f, hf, hord, (hf.analyticAt z₀).analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.mp h0, by simp⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    intro f hf hord hordle
    by_cases hz₀ : f z₀ = 0
    · obtain ⟨h, hhd, hhord, hfac⟩ := exists_entire_div_of_zero_gen hf hord hz₀
      have hprod : f = (fun z : ℂ => z - z₀) * h := funext fun z => by simpa using hfac z
      have hmono : analyticOrderAt (fun z : ℂ => z - z₀) z₀ = 1 := by
        simpa using analyticOrderAt_centeredMonomial (𝕜 := ℂ) (z₀ := z₀) (n := 1)
      have hsum : analyticOrderAt f z₀ = 1 + analyticOrderAt h z₀ := by
        rw [hprod, analyticOrderAt_mul (by fun_prop) (hhd.analyticAt z₀), hmono]
      have hordh : analyticOrderAt h z₀ ≤ (m : ℕ∞) := by
        refine (ENat.add_le_add_iff_left (k := 1) (by simp)).mp ?_
        rw [← hsum]
        refine hordle.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
        push_cast
        ring
      obtain ⟨j, g, hg, hgord, hgz, hgfac⟩ := ih h hhd hhord hordh
      refine ⟨j + 1, g, hg, hgord, hgz, fun z => ?_⟩
      rw [hfac z, hgfac z]
      ring
    · exact ⟨0, f, hf, hord, hz₀, by simp⟩

name: XiLab.exists_poly_mul_exp_aux_gen
statement:
theorem exists_poly_mul_exp_aux_gen :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → HasOrderLeOne f →
      {z : ℂ | f z = 0}.Finite → {z : ℂ | f z = 0}.ncard = k →
      ∃ (P : Polynomial ℂ) (a b : ℂ), ∀ z, f z = P.eval z * Complex.exp (a * z + b)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro f hf hord hfin hcard
    have hempty : {z : ℂ | f z = 0} = ∅ := (Set.ncard_eq_zero hfin).mp hcard
    have hnz : ∀ z, f z ≠ 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hmem : z ∈ ({z : ℂ | f z = 0}) := hz
      rw [hempty] at hmem
      exact hmem
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := eq_exp_affine_of_hasOrderLeOne hf hnz hord
    exact ⟨1, a, b, fun z => by rw [hab z]; simp⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro f hf hord hfin hcard
    have hne : {z : ℂ | f z = 0}.Nonempty := by
      rw [Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
      intro hc
      rw [hc] at hcard
      simp at hcard
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := hne
    have hfne : ¬ (f = 0) := by
      rintro rfl
      have huniv : {z : ℂ | (0 : ℂ → ℂ) z = 0} = Set.univ := by ext; simp
      rw [huniv] at hfin
      exact Set.infinite_univ hfin
    have hordne : analyticOrderAt f z₀ ≠ ⊤ := by
      rw [ne_eq, AnalyticOnNhd.analyticOrderAt_eq_top_iff_eq_zero z₀ fun w => hf.analyticAt w]
      exact hfne
    have hle : analyticOrderAt f z₀ ≤ (((analyticOrderAt f z₀).toNat : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
      le_of_eq (ENat.coe_toNat hordne).symm
    obtain ⟨j, g, hg, hgord, hgz, hgfac⟩ :=
      exists_pow_mul_of_hasOrderLeOne z₀ _ f hf hord hle
    have hzero : {z : ℂ | g z = 0} = {z : ℂ | f z = 0} \ {z₀} := by
      ext w
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      constructor
      · intro hw
        refine ⟨by rw [hgfac w, hw, mul_zero], ?_⟩
        rintro rfl
        exact hgz hw
      · rintro ⟨hw, hnew⟩
        have hz := hgfac w
        rw [hw] at hz
        have hpow : (w - z₀) ^ j ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (sub_ne_zero_of_ne hnew)
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz.symm).resolve_left hpow
    have hfin' : {z : ℂ | g z = 0}.Finite := by
      rw [hzero]; exact hfin.sdiff
    have hcard' : {z : ℂ | g z = 0}.ncard = k := by
      have h1 : ({z : ℂ | f z = 0} \ {z₀}).ncard + 1 = {z : ℂ | f z = 0}.ncard :=
        Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one hz₀ hfin
      rw [hcard] at h1
      rw [hzero]
      omega
    obtain ⟨Q, a, b, hQ⟩ := ih g hg hgord hfin' hcard'
    refine ⟨(Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C z₀) ^ j * Q, a, b, fun z => ?_⟩
    rw [hgfac z, hQ z]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_sub,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
    ring

name: XiLab.exists_poly_mul_exp_of_finite_zeros_of_hasOrderLeOne
proof:
:=
  exists_poly_mul_exp_aux_gen _ f hf hord hfin rfl

name: XiLab.exists_zero_of_not_eq_exp_affine_of_hasOrderLeOne
statement:
theorem exists_zero_of_not_eq_exp_affine_of_hasOrderLeOne {f : ℂ → ℂ}

name: XiLab.hasOrderLeOne_of_exp_type
statement:
theorem hasOrderLeOne_of_exp_type {f : ℂ → ℂ} {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    (hgrowth : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖f z‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖)) : HasOrderLeOne f
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  set B' : ℝ := max B 1 with hB'_def
  have hB'1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ B' := le_max_right _ _
  have hB'0 : (0 : ℝ) < B' := by linarith
  have hBB' : B ≤ B' := le_max_left _ _
  set T : ℝ := B' ^ ((1 : ℝ) / ε) with hT_def
  have hT1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ T := by rw [hT_def]; exact Real.one_le_rpow hB'1 (by positivity)
  have hT0 : (0 : ℝ) < T := by linarith
  have hTe : T ^ ε = B' := by
    rw [hT_def, ← Real.rpow_mul hB'0.le, one_div_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt hε), Real.rpow_one]
  have hyoung : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → B' * r ≤ B' * T + r ^ (1 + ε) := by
    intro r hr
    have hrp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ r ^ (1 + ε) := Real.rpow_nonneg hr _
    rcases le_or_gt r T with h | h
    · have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hB'0.le
      linarith
    · have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r := lt_trans hT0 h
      have hsplit : r ^ (1 + ε) = r * r ^ ε := by rw [Real.rpow_add hr0, Real.rpow_one]
      have hmono : T ^ ε ≤ r ^ ε := Real.rpow_le_rpow hT0.le h.le hε.le
      rw [hTe] at hmono
      rw [hsplit]
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hr0.le
      have h3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ B' * T := mul_nonneg hB'0.le hT0.le
      linarith
  set D : ℝ := max (A * Real.exp (B' * T)) 1 with hD_def
  have hD1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ D := by rw [hD_def]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) < D := by linarith
  refine ⟨D, hD0, fun z => ?_⟩
  have hz : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ := norm_nonneg z
  have hrp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ ^ (1 + ε) := Real.rpow_nonneg hz _
  have hle1 : A * Real.exp (B' * T) ≤ D := by rw [hD_def]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hle2 : ‖z‖ ^ (1 + ε) ≤ D * ‖z‖ ^ (1 + ε) := by nlinarith
  calc ‖f z‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖) := hgrowth z
    _ ≤ A * Real.exp (B' * T + ‖z‖ ^ (1 + ε)) := by
        have h1 : B * ‖z‖ ≤ B' * T + ‖z‖ ^ (1 + ε) := by
          have hy := hyoung ‖z‖ hz
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hBB' hz
          linarith
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h1) hA.le
    _ = A * Real.exp (B' * T) * Real.exp (‖z‖ ^ (1 + ε)) := by rw [Real.exp_add]; ring
    _ ≤ D * Real.exp (‖z‖ ^ (1 + ε)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle1 (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ ≤ D * Real.exp (D * ‖z‖ ^ (1 + ε)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hle2) hD0.le

name: XiLab.eq_exp_affine_of_exp_type
statement:
theorem eq_exp_affine_of_exp_type {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hnz : ∀ z, f z ≠ 0) {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    (hgrowth : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖f z‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖)) :
    ∃ a b : ℂ, ∀ z, f z = Complex.exp (a * z + b)
proof:
:=
  eq_exp_affine_of_hasOrderLeOne hf hnz (hasOrderLeOne_of_exp_type hA hgrowth)

name: XiLab.exists_poly_mul_exp_of_finite_zeros_of_exp_type
statement:
theorem exists_poly_mul_exp_of_finite_zeros_of_exp_type {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hgrowth : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖f z‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖))
    (hfin : {z : ℂ | f z = 0}.Finite) :
    ∃ (P : Polynomial ℂ) (a b : ℂ), ∀ z, f z = P.eval z * Complex.exp (a * z + b)
proof:
:=
  exists_poly_mul_exp_of_finite_zeros_of_hasOrderLeOne hf
    (hasOrderLeOne_of_exp_type hA hgrowth) hfin

name: XiLab.setIntegral_Phi_mul_rsinh_pos
statement:
theorem setIntegral_Phi_mul_rsinh_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    0 < ∫ u in Ioi (0:ℝ), Phi u * Real.sinh (x * u)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : ∀ u ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ), 0 < Phi u * Real.sinh (x * u) := by
    intro u hu
    have hu0 : (0:ℝ) < u := mem_Ioi.mp hu
    exact mul_pos (Phi_pos hu0.le) (Real.sinh_pos_iff.mpr (mul_pos hx hu0))
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioi (0:ℝ))] fun u : ℝ => Phi u * Real.sinh (x * u) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
    exact (hpos u hu).le
  rw [setIntegral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae hnonneg (integrableOn_Phi_mul_rsinh x)]
  have hsupp : Function.support (fun u : ℝ => Phi u * Real.sinh (x * u)) ∩ Ioi (0:ℝ)
      = Ioi (0:ℝ) :=
    Set.inter_eq_right.mpr fun u hu => ne_of_gt (hpos u hu)
  rw [hsupp, Real.volume_Ioi]
  exact ENNReal.zero_lt_top

name: XiLab.exists_entire_primitive
statement:
theorem exists_entire_primitive {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Differentiable ℂ h) :
    ∃ H : ℂ → ℂ, Differentiable ℂ H ∧ ∀ z, HasDerivAt H (h z) z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := hh.isExactOn_univ

name: XiLab.const_mul_exp_neg_primitive
statement:
theorem const_mul_exp_neg_primitive {f G : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hnz : ∀ z, f z ≠ 0) (hG : ∀ z, HasDerivAt G (deriv f z / f z) z) (z w : ℂ) :
    f z * Complex.exp (-G z) = f w * Complex.exp (-G w)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x : ℂ, HasDerivAt (fun y => f y * Complex.exp (-G y)) 0 x := by
    intro x
    have h1 : HasDerivAt f (deriv f x) x := (hf x).hasDerivAt
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y => Complex.exp (-G y))
        (Complex.exp (-G x) * -(deriv f x / f x)) x := ((hG x).neg).cexp
    have h3 := h1.mul h2
    have h4 : deriv f x * Complex.exp (-G x)
        + f x * (Complex.exp (-G x) * -(deriv f x / f x)) = 0 := by
      have hx := hnz x
      field_simp
      ring
    rwa [h4] at h3
  exact is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun x => (key x).differentiableAt)
    (fun x => (key x).deriv) z w

name: XiLab.exists_entire_log
statement:
theorem exists_entire_log {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (hnz : ∀ z, f z ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, Differentiable ℂ g ∧ ∀ z, f z = Complex.exp (g z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hGd, hG⟩ := exists_entire_primitive (differentiable_logDeriv hf hnz)
  have hc : f 0 * Complex.exp (-G 0) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (hnz 0) (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
  refine ⟨fun z => G z + Complex.log (f 0 * Complex.exp (-G 0)), hGd.add_const _, fun z => ?_⟩
  rw [Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_log hc,
    ← const_mul_exp_neg_primitive hf hnz hG z 0, mul_comm, mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
  simp

      ∀ z, f z = Complex.exp (g z)
proof:

  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀d, hg₀⟩ := exists_entire_log hf hnz
  refine ⟨fun z => g₀ z - g₀ 0 + Complex.log (f 0), by fun_prop, by simp, fun z => ?_⟩
  have h0 := hnz 0
  rw [Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_sub, Complex.exp_log h0, ← hg₀ z, ← hg₀ 0]
  field_simp

theorem exists_entire_log_with_val_at {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)

lemma hasDerivAt_Eterm (i : ℕ) (u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (Eterm i) ((1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ)) * Eterm i u - 2 * Eterm (i + 1) u) u
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp ((1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ)) * v))
      (Real.exp ((1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ)) * u) * (1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ))) u := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul (1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ))).exp
  have h := hexp.mul (hasDerivAt_T i u)
  have hE : Real.exp ((1 / 2 + 2 * ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * u)
      = Real.exp ((1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ)) * u) * Real.exp (2 * u) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
  have heq : (1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ)) * Eterm i u - 2 * Eterm (i + 1) u
      = Real.exp ((1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ)) * u) * (1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ)) * T i u
        + Real.exp ((1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ)) * u) * (-2 * Real.exp (2 * u) * T (i + 1) u) := by
    simp only [Eterm]
    rw [hE]; ring
  rw [heq]
  exact h

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_G
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_G (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h13 : a 13 = 0) (u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (G a) (G (stp a) u) u
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun v : ℝ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 14, a i * Eterm i v)
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 14, (fun v : ℝ => a i * Eterm i v) := by
    funext v; simp
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 14, a i * Eterm i v)
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 14,
        a i * ((1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ)) * Eterm i u - 2 * Eterm (i + 1) u)) u := by
    rw [hfun]
    exact HasDerivAt.sum (fun i _ => (hasDerivAt_Eterm i u).const_mul (a i))
  have e2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 14, a i * Eterm (i + 1) u
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 14, shf a i * Eterm i u := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ (fun i => a i * Eterm (i + 1) u) 13,
      Finset.sum_range_succ' (fun i => shf a i * Eterm i u) 13]
    simp [shf, h13]
  have key : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 14,
        a i * ((1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ)) * Eterm i u - 2 * Eterm (i + 1) u)
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 14, stp a i * Eterm i u := by
    have e1 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 14,
          a i * ((1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ)) * Eterm i u - 2 * Eterm (i + 1) u)
        = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 14, (1 / 2 + 2 * (i : ℝ)) * a i * Eterm i u)
          - 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 14, a i * Eterm (i + 1) u := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
    rw [e1, e2, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by simp only [stp]; ring)
  rw [G, ← key]
  exact h
