  calc |phiTerm n u|
      = |4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) -
          6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2)| *
            Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) := by
        rw [phiTerm, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right habs (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: XiLab.abs_phiTerm_le
statement:
lemma abs_phiTerm_le (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ) :
    |phiTerm n u| ≤
      (4 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) + 6 * π * Real.exp (5 * u / 2)) *
        ((n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have hx0 : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp (2 * u) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hsq := cast_sq_le_pow_four n
  have hE : Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) ≤
      Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))) ^ n := by
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (cast_le_sq n) (le_of_lt (mul_pos hpi hx0))]
  have hA : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) := by positivity
  have hB : (0:ℝ) ≤ 6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) := by positivity
  calc |phiTerm n u|
      ≤ (4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) +
          6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2)) *
            Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) := abs_phiTerm_le_aux n u
    _ ≤ (4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) +
          6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2)) *
            Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))) ^ n :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (by linarith)
    _ ≤ (4 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) + 6 * π * Real.exp (5 * u / 2)) *
          ((n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))) ^ n) := by
        have hpow : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))) ^ n :=
          pow_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le n
        have h5 : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp (5 * u / 2) := Real.exp_pos _
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq
          (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 6 * π * Real.exp (5 * u / 2))]

name: XiLab.norm_exp_neg_pi_exp_lt_one
statement:
lemma norm_exp_neg_pi_exp_lt_one (u : ℝ) :
    ‖Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u)))‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  rw [Real.exp_lt_one_iff]
  have : (0:ℝ) < π * Real.exp (2 * u) := mul_pos Real.pi_pos (Real.exp_pos _)
  linarith

name: XiLab.summable_phiTerm
statement: theorem summable_phiTerm (u : ℝ) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => phiTerm n u)
proof:
:= by
  have hs :=
    (summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one 4 (norm_exp_neg_pi_exp_lt_one u)).mul_left
      (4 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) + 6 * π * Real.exp (5 * u / 2))
  refine Summable.of_norm_bounded hs (fun n => ?_)
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using abs_phiTerm_le n u

name: XiLab.summable_phiTerm_succ
statement: lemma summable_phiTerm_succ (u : ℝ) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => phiTerm (n + 1) u)
proof:
:=
  (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (summable_phiTerm u)

name: XiLab.Phi_eq_tsum
statement: lemma Phi_eq_tsum (u : ℝ) : Phi u = ∑' n : ℕ, phiTerm n u
proof:
:= by
  rw [(summable_phiTerm u).tsum_eq_zero_add, phiTerm_zero, zero_add]
  rfl

name: XiLab.abs_phiTerm_le_of_mem_Icc
statement:
lemma abs_phiTerm_le_of_mem_Icc {a b : ℝ} (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) :
    |phiTerm n x| ≤
      (4 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (9 * b / 2) + 6 * π * Real.exp (5 * b / 2)) *
        ((n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hax, hxb⟩ := hx
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  refine (abs_phiTerm_le n x).trans ?_
  have h1 : Real.exp (9 * x / 2) ≤ Real.exp (9 * b / 2) :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have h2 : Real.exp (5 * x / 2) ≤ Real.exp (5 * b / 2) :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have h3 : Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * x))) ≤ Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have : Real.exp (2 * a) ≤ Real.exp (2 * x) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have h4 : Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * x))) ^ n ≤ Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.exp_pos _).le h3 n
  have hn4 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 4 := by positivity
  have hpow : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * x))) ^ n := pow_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le n
  have hC : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (9 * x / 2) + 6 * π * Real.exp (5 * x / 2) := by
    positivity
  calc (4 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (9 * x / 2) + 6 * π * Real.exp (5 * x / 2)) *
        ((n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * x))) ^ n)
      ≤ (4 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (9 * x / 2) + 6 * π * Real.exp (5 * x / 2)) *
        ((n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hn4) hC
    _ ≤ (4 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (9 * b / 2) + 6 * π * Real.exp (5 * b / 2)) *
        ((n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n) := by
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
        nlinarith

name: XiLab.continuousOn_Phi_Icc
statement: theorem continuousOn_Phi_Icc (a b : ℝ) : ContinuousOn Phi (Icc a b)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ‖Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a)))‖ < 1 := norm_exp_neg_pi_exp_lt_one a
  have hgeo : Summable
      (fun m : ℕ => (m : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ m) :=
    summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one 4 hr
  have hshift : Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ (n + 1)) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff
      (f := fun m : ℕ => (m : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ m) 1).mpr hgeo
  have hsum := hshift.mul_left
    (4 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (9 * b / 2) + 6 * π * Real.exp (5 * b / 2))
  have main : ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑' n : ℕ, phiTerm (n + 1) x) (Icc a b) :=
    continuousOn_tsum (fun n => (continuous_phiTerm (n + 1)).continuousOn) hsum
      (fun n x hx => by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using abs_phiTerm_le_of_mem_Icc (n + 1) hx)
  exact main

name: XiLab.continuous_Phi
statement: theorem continuous_Phi : Continuous Phi
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro u₀
  exact (continuousOn_Phi_Icc (u₀ - 1) (u₀ + 1)).continuousAt
    (Icc_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))

name: XiLab.phiTerm_pos
statement: theorem phiTerm_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : 0 < phiTerm n u
proof:
:= by
  have hpi3 : (3:ℝ) < π := Real.pi_gt_three
  have hn1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hn2 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hn4 : (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 4 := cast_sq_le_pow_four n
  have hx : (1:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (2 * u) := Real.one_le_exp (by linarith)
  have hsplit : Real.exp (9 * u / 2) = Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * Real.exp (2 * u) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
  have h5 : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp (5 * u / 2) := Real.exp_pos _
  
  have step1 : 6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 < 4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [mul_pos (mul_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * π) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 2 * π - 3))
      (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < (n : ℝ) ^ 2)]
  have step2 : 4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn4 (by positivity)
  have step3 : 4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤ 4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (2 * u) := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4)]
  have key : 6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 < 4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (2 * u) := by
    linarith
  rw [phiTerm, hsplit]
  refine mul_pos ?_ (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hfac : 4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * (Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * Real.exp (2 * u)) -
      6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) =
      Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * (4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (2 * u) -
        6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) := by ring
  rw [hfac]
  exact mul_pos h5 (by linarith)

name: XiLab.Phi_pos
statement: theorem Phi_pos {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : 0 < Phi u
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < phiTerm (n + 1) u := fun n =>
    phiTerm_pos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) hu
  have := (summable_phiTerm_succ u).le_tsum 0 (fun j _ => (hterm j).le)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hterm 0) this

name: XiLab.Phi_nonneg
statement: theorem Phi_nonneg {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : 0 ≤ Phi u
proof: := (Phi_pos hu).le

name: XiLab.envTerm_nonneg
statement: lemma envTerm_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ envTerm n
proof:
:= by
  have := Real.pi_pos; unfold envTerm; positivity

name: XiLab.summable_envTerm
statement: theorem summable_envTerm : Summable envTerm
proof:
:= by
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have hr : ‖Real.exp (-π)‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), Real.exp_lt_one_iff]; linarith
  have hs := (summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one 4 hr).mul_left
    (Real.exp π * (4 * π ^ 2 + 6 * π))
  refine Summable.of_norm_bounded hs (fun n => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (envTerm_nonneg n)]
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(π * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1))) ≤ Real.exp π * Real.exp (-π) ^ n := by
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_add]
    refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (cast_le_sq n) hpi.le]
  have hcoef : 4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 + 6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (4 * π ^ 2 + 6 * π) * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (cast_sq_le_pow_four n)
      (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 6 * π)]
  calc envTerm n
      ≤ ((4 * π ^ 2 + 6 * π) * (n : ℝ) ^ 4) * (Real.exp π * Real.exp (-π) ^ n) := by
        refine mul_le_mul hcoef hexp (Real.exp_pos _).le (by positivity)
    _ = Real.exp π * (4 * π ^ 2 + 6 * π) * ((n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-π) ^ n) := by ring

name: XiLab.phiConst_nonneg
statement: theorem phiConst_nonneg : 0 ≤ phiConst
proof:
:=
  tsum_nonneg envTerm_nonneg

name: XiLab.abs_phiTerm_le_envTerm
statement:
lemma abs_phiTerm_le_envTerm (n : ℕ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    |phiTerm n u| ≤
      envTerm n * (Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))))
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp [envTerm]
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have hn1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hn2 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hx : (1:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (2 * u) := Real.one_le_exp (by linarith)
  have hA : Real.exp (5 * u / 2) ≤ Real.exp (9 * u / 2) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hB : Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) ≤
      Real.exp (-(π * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1))) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hpi.le
      (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hn2) (sub_nonneg.mpr hx))]
  have hcoef : 4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) +
      6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) ≤
      (4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 + 6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2)]
  calc |phiTerm n u|
      ≤ (4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) +
          6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2)) *
            Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) := abs_phiTerm_le_aux n u
    _ ≤ ((4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 + 6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * Real.exp (9 * u / 2)) *
          (Real.exp (-(π * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1))) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u)))) :=
        mul_le_mul hcoef hB (Real.exp_pos _).le (by positivity)
    _ = envTerm n * (Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u)))) := by
        unfold envTerm; ring

name: XiLab.abs_Phi_le
statement:
theorem abs_Phi_le {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    |Phi u| ≤ phiConst * (Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))))
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : Summable (fun n : ℕ => phiTerm n u) := summable_phiTerm u
  have hA : Summable (fun n : ℕ => |phiTerm n u|) := hsum.abs
  have hbound : Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      envTerm n * (Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))))) :=
    summable_envTerm.mul_right _
  calc |Phi u| = |∑' n : ℕ, phiTerm n u| := by rw [Phi_eq_tsum]
    _ ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, |phiTerm n u| := by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (f := fun n : ℕ => phiTerm n u)
            (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hA)
    _ ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, envTerm n * (Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u)))) :=
        hA.tsum_le_tsum (fun n => abs_phiTerm_le_envTerm n hu) hbound
    _ = phiConst * (Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u)))) :=
        tsum_mul_right

name: XiLab.Phi_le
statement:
theorem Phi_le {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    Phi u ≤ phiConst * (Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))))
proof:
:=
  (le_abs_self _).trans (abs_Phi_le hu)

name: XiLab.two_sq_le_exp_two_mul
statement: lemma two_sq_le_exp_two_mul {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : 2 * u ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (2 * u)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (1:ℝ) + 2 * u + (2 * u) ^ 2 / 2 ≤ Real.exp (2 * u) := by
    have := Real.sum_le_exp_of_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * u by linarith) 3
    simpa [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial] using this
  nlinarith

name: XiLab.exp_envelope_le
statement:
theorem exp_envelope_le (a : ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    Real.exp (a * u) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))) ≤
      Real.exp ((a + 1) ^ 2 / (8 * π)) * Real.exp (-u)
proof:
:= by
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
  refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
  have h1 : 2 * π * u ^ 2 ≤ π * Real.exp (2 * u) := by
    nlinarith [two_sq_le_exp_two_mul hu]
  have hq : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * π * (u - (a + 1) / (4 * π)) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have he : 2 * π * (u - (a + 1) / (4 * π)) ^ 2 =
      2 * π * u ^ 2 - (a + 1) * u + (a + 1) ^ 2 / (8 * π) := by
    field_simp; ring
  rw [he] at hq
  linarith

name: XiLab.integrableOn_exp_envelope
statement:
theorem integrableOn_exp_envelope (a : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn
      (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (a * u) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u)))) (Ioi (0:ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hint : IntegrableOn
      (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp ((a + 1) ^ 2 / (8 * π)) * Real.exp (-1 * u)) (Ioi (0:ℝ)) :=
    (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 one_pos).const_mul _
  refine Integrable.mono' hint (Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable (by fun_prop)) ?_
  filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
  simpa [neg_one_mul] using exp_envelope_le a (le_of_lt hu)

name: XiLab.integrableOn_of_le_envelope
statement:
theorem integrableOn_of_le_envelope {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (f : ℝ → E) (a C : ℝ)
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict (Ioi (0:ℝ))))
    (hb : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u →
      ‖f u‖ ≤ C * (Real.exp (a * u) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))))) :
    IntegrableOn f (Ioi (0:ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine Integrable.mono' ((integrableOn_exp_envelope a).const_mul C) hf ?_
  filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu using hb u hu

name: XiLab.abs_Phi_mul_exp_le
statement:
theorem abs_Phi_mul_exp_le (a : ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    |Phi u| * Real.exp (a * u) ≤
      phiConst * Real.exp ((9 / 2 + a + 1) ^ 2 / (8 * π)) * Real.exp (-u)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : |Phi u| * Real.exp (a * u) ≤
      phiConst * (Real.exp ((9 / 2 + a) * u) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u)))) := by
    calc |Phi u| * Real.exp (a * u)
        ≤ (phiConst * (Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))))) *
            Real.exp (a * u) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (abs_Phi_le hu) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = phiConst * (Real.exp ((9 / 2 + a) * u) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u)))) := by
          rw [show (9 / 2 + a) * u = 9 * u / 2 + a * u by ring, Real.exp_add]; ring
  refine h1.trans ?_
  calc phiConst * (Real.exp ((9 / 2 + a) * u) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))))
      ≤ phiConst * (Real.exp ((9 / 2 + a + 1) ^ 2 / (8 * π)) * Real.exp (-u)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (exp_envelope_le (9 / 2 + a) hu) phiConst_nonneg
    _ = phiConst * Real.exp ((9 / 2 + a + 1) ^ 2 / (8 * π)) * Real.exp (-u) := by ring

name: XiLab.tendsto_Phi_mul_exp_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_Phi_mul_exp_atTop (a : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => Phi u * Real.exp (a * u)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hupper : Tendsto
      (fun u : ℝ => phiConst * Real.exp ((9 / 2 + a + 1) ^ 2 / (8 * π)) * Real.exp (-u))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using Real.tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero.const_mul
      (phiConst * Real.exp ((9 / 2 + a + 1) ^ 2 / (8 * π)))
  refine squeeze_zero' (Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨0, fun u hu => ?_⟩)
    (Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨0, fun u hu => ?_⟩) hupper
  · exact mul_nonneg (Phi_nonneg hu) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  · exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
      (abs_Phi_mul_exp_le a hu)

name: XiLab.tendsto_Phi_atTop
statement: theorem tendsto_Phi_atTop : Tendsto Phi atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using tendsto_Phi_mul_exp_atTop 0

name: XiLab.norm_complex_sinh_le
statement: lemma norm_complex_sinh_le (z : ℂ) : ‖Complex.sinh z‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖z‖
proof:
:= by
  have hre : |z.re| ≤ ‖z‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm z
  have e1 : Real.exp z.re ≤ Real.exp ‖z‖ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((le_abs_self _).trans hre)
  have e2 : Real.exp (-z.re) ≤ Real.exp ‖z‖ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((neg_le_abs _).trans hre)
  have h1 : ‖Complex.exp z‖ = Real.exp z.re := Complex.norm_exp z
  have h2 : ‖Complex.exp (-z)‖ = Real.exp (-z.re) := by rw [Complex.norm_exp]; simp
  have hdef : Complex.sinh z = (Complex.exp z - Complex.exp (-z)) / 2 := rfl
  have htri := norm_sub_le (Complex.exp z) (Complex.exp (-z))
  rw [h1, h2] at htri
  rw [hdef, norm_div, show ‖(2:ℂ)‖ = 2 by norm_num]
  linarith

name: XiLab.norm_complex_cosh_le
statement: lemma norm_complex_cosh_le (z : ℂ) : ‖Complex.cosh z‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖z‖
proof:
:= by
  have hre : |z.re| ≤ ‖z‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm z
  have e1 : Real.exp z.re ≤ Real.exp ‖z‖ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((le_abs_self _).trans hre)
  have e2 : Real.exp (-z.re) ≤ Real.exp ‖z‖ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((neg_le_abs _).trans hre)
  have h1 : ‖Complex.exp z‖ = Real.exp z.re := Complex.norm_exp z
  have h2 : ‖Complex.exp (-z)‖ = Real.exp (-z.re) := by rw [Complex.norm_exp]; simp
  have hdef : Complex.cosh z = (Complex.exp z + Complex.exp (-z)) / 2 := rfl
  have htri := norm_add_le (Complex.exp z) (Complex.exp (-z))
  rw [h1, h2] at htri
  rw [hdef, norm_div, show ‖(2:ℂ)‖ = 2 by norm_num]
  linarith

name: XiLab.norm_mul_ofReal
statement: lemma norm_mul_ofReal (w : ℂ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : ‖w * (u : ℂ)‖ = ‖w‖ * u
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hu]

name: XiLab.norm_Phi_mul_le
statement:
lemma norm_Phi_mul_le {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (r : ℝ) (v : ℂ) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ Real.exp (r * u)) :
    ‖(Phi u : ℂ) * v‖ ≤
      phiConst * (Real.exp ((9 / 2 + r) * u) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))))
proof:
:= by
  have hu0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ u := hu.le
  rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  calc |Phi u| * ‖v‖
      ≤ (phiConst * (Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))))) *
          Real.exp (r * u) :=
        mul_le_mul (abs_Phi_le hu0) hv (norm_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg phiConst_nonneg (by positivity))
    _ = phiConst * (Real.exp ((9 / 2 + r) * u) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u)))) := by
        rw [show (9 / 2 + r) * u = 9 * u / 2 + r * u by ring, Real.exp_add]; ring

name: XiLab.continuous_Phi_mul_sinh
statement:
lemma continuous_Phi_mul_sinh (w : ℂ) :
    Continuous (fun u : ℝ => (Phi u : ℂ) * Complex.sinh (w * u))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => ((Phi u : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
    Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_Phi
  have h2 : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => Complex.sinh (w * (u : ℂ))) :=
    Complex.differentiable_sinh.continuous.comp
      (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal)
  exact h1.mul h2

name: XiLab.continuous_Phi_mul_cosh_mul
statement:
lemma continuous_Phi_mul_cosh_mul (w : ℂ) :
    Continuous (fun u : ℝ => (Phi u : ℂ) * (Complex.cosh (w * u) * (u : ℂ)))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => ((Phi u : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
    Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_Phi
  have h2 : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => Complex.cosh (w * (u : ℂ))) :=
    Complex.differentiable_cosh.continuous.comp
      (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal)
  exact h1.mul (h2.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal)

name: XiLab.integrableOn_Phi_mul_sinh
statement:
theorem integrableOn_Phi_mul_sinh (w : ℂ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => (Phi u : ℂ) * Complex.sinh (w * u)) (Ioi (0:ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine integrableOn_of_le_envelope _ (9 / 2 + ‖w‖) phiConst
    ((continuous_Phi_mul_sinh w).aestronglyMeasurable) (fun u hu => ?_)
  refine norm_Phi_mul_le hu ‖w‖ _ ?_
  refine (norm_complex_sinh_le _).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
  rw [norm_mul_ofReal w hu.le]

name: XiLab.integrableOn_Phi_mul_rsinh
statement:
theorem integrableOn_Phi_mul_rsinh (a : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Phi u * Real.sinh (a * u)) (Ioi (0:ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => Phi u * Real.sinh (a * u)) := by
    exact continuous_Phi.mul (Real.continuous_sinh.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id))
  refine integrableOn_of_le_envelope _ (9 / 2 + |a|) phiConst hcont.aestronglyMeasurable
    (fun u hu => ?_)
  have hu0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ u := hu.le
  have hsinh : |Real.sinh (a * u)| ≤ Real.exp (|a| * u) := by
    have h := norm_complex_sinh_le ((a * u : ℝ) : ℂ)
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_sinh, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul] at h
    exact h.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hu0]))
  have := norm_Phi_mul_le hu |a| ((Real.sinh (a * u) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    (by rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hsinh)
  rwa [← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this

name: XiLab.differentiableAt_integral_Phi_sinh
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_integral_Phi_sinh (w₀ : ℂ) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ
      (fun w : ℂ => ∫ u in Ioi (0:ℝ), (Phi u : ℂ) * Complex.sinh (w * u)) w₀
proof:
:= by
  set μ : Measure ℝ := volume.restrict (Ioi (0:ℝ)) with hμ
  set R : ℝ := ‖w₀‖ + 1 with hRdef
  set bnd : ℝ → ℝ := fun u =>
    phiConst * (Real.exp ((9 / 2 + (R + 1)) * u) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u)))) with hbnd
  have hbnd_int : Integrable bnd μ := (integrableOn_exp_envelope _).const_mul _
  have h_diff : ∀ᵐ u ∂μ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₀ 1,
      HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (Phi u : ℂ) * Complex.sinh (z * u))
        ((Phi u : ℂ) * (Complex.cosh (w * u) * (u : ℂ))) w := by
    filter_upwards with u w _
    exact (((hasDerivAt_mul_const (u : ℂ)).csinh).const_mul ((Phi u : ℝ) : ℂ))
  have h_bound : ∀ᵐ u ∂μ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₀ 1,
      ‖(Phi u : ℂ) * (Complex.cosh (w * u) * (u : ℂ))‖ ≤ bnd u := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu w hw
    have hu0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ u := (mem_Ioi.mp hu).le
    have hwR : ‖w‖ ≤ R := by
      have hd : ‖w - w₀‖ < 1 := by
        rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hw
      have := norm_sub_norm_le w w₀
      rw [hRdef]; linarith
    refine norm_Phi_mul_le (mem_Ioi.mp hu) (R + 1) _ ?_
    have hc : ‖Complex.cosh (w * (u : ℂ))‖ ≤ Real.exp (R * u) := by
      refine (norm_complex_cosh_le _).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
      rw [norm_mul_ofReal w hu0]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hwR hu0
    have hue : u ≤ Real.exp u := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp u]
    calc ‖Complex.cosh (w * (u : ℂ)) * (u : ℂ)‖
        = ‖Complex.cosh (w * (u : ℂ))‖ * u := by
          rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hu0]
      _ ≤ Real.exp (R * u) * Real.exp u :=
          mul_le_mul hc hue hu0 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp ((R + 1) * u) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
  have key := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (μ := μ) (bound := bnd)
    (F := fun (z : ℂ) (u : ℝ) => (Phi u : ℂ) * Complex.sinh (z * u))
    (F' := fun (z : ℂ) (u : ℝ) => (Phi u : ℂ) * (Complex.cosh (z * u) * (u : ℂ)))
    (x₀ := w₀) (s := Metric.ball w₀ 1)
    (Metric.ball_mem_nhds w₀ one_pos)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      (fun z => (continuous_Phi_mul_sinh z).aestronglyMeasurable))
    (integrableOn_Phi_mul_sinh w₀)
    ((continuous_Phi_mul_cosh_mul w₀).aestronglyMeasurable)
    h_bound hbnd_int h_diff
  exact key.2.differentiableAt

name: XiLab.differentiable_F
statement: theorem differentiable_F : Differentiable ℂ F
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  exact ((differentiableAt_integral_Phi_sinh w).const_mul 2)

name: XiLab.exp_nine_halves
statement:
lemma exp_nine_halves (u : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (9 * u / 2) = Real.exp (2 * u) * Real.exp (5 * u / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_phiTerm
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_phiTerm (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (phiTerm n) (phiTerm' n u) u
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => 2 * v) (2 : ℝ) u := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul (2 : ℝ)
  have h5 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => 5 * v / 2) (5 / 2 : ℝ) u := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul (5 : ℝ)).div_const 2
  have h9 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => 9 * v / 2) (9 / 2 : ℝ) u := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul (9 : ℝ)).div_const 2
  have e2 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * v)) (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2) u := h2.exp
  have e5 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (5 * v / 2))
      (Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * (5 / 2)) u := h5.exp
  have e9 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (9 * v / 2))
      (Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * (9 / 2)) u := h9.exp
  have hb : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v))))
      (Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) *
        (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2)))) u :=
    ((e2.const_mul (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2)).neg).exp
  have ha : HasDerivAt
      (fun v : ℝ => 4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (9 * v / 2) -
        6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * v / 2))
      (4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * (Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * (9 / 2)) -
        6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * (5 / 2))) u :=
    (e9.const_mul _).sub (e5.const_mul _)
  have hfun : phiTerm n = fun v : ℝ =>
      (4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (9 * v / 2) -
        6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * v / 2)) *
      Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * v))) := rfl
  have heq :
      (4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * (Real.exp (9 * u / 2) * (9 / 2)) -
        6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * u / 2) * (5 / 2))) *
        Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) +
      (4 * π ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (9 * u / 2) -
        6 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2)) *
        (Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) *
          (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (2 * u) * 2))))
      = phiTerm' n u := by
    rw [phiTerm', exp_nine_halves]; ring
  rw [hfun, ← heq]
  exact ha.mul hb

name: XiLab.sq_le_pow_six
statement: lemma sq_le_pow_six (n : ℕ) : (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | h

name: XiLab.pow_four_le_pow_six

name: XiLab.summable_derivBound
statement: theorem summable_derivBound (a b : ℝ) : Summable (derivBound a b)

:=
  (summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one 6 (norm_exp_neg_pi_exp_lt_one a)).mul_left _

name: XiLab.abs_phiTerm'_le
statement:
lemma abs_phiTerm'_le {a b : ℝ} (n : ℕ) {u : ℝ} (hau : a ≤ u) (hub : u ≤ b) :
    |phiTerm' n u| ≤ derivBound a b n
proof:
:= by
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  have hEu : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp (2 * u) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) := by positivity
  
  have hrw : phiTerm' n u =
      -((π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * u / 2) *
          Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))))) *
        (8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 -
          30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) + 15)) := by
    rw [phiTerm']; ring
  have hAnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * u / 2) *
      Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)))) := by positivity
  rw [hrw, abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hAnn]
  
  have hP : |8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 -
      30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) + 15| ≤
      8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 +
        30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) + 15 := by
    refine abs_le.mpr ⟨by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))],
      by nlinarith⟩
  
  have hEb : Real.exp (2 * u) ≤ Real.exp (2 * b) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hQ : 8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 +
      30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) + 15 ≤
      8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 2 +
        30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) + 15 := by
    have h1 : (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ≤ (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) := by
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [hx0]
  
  have h5b : Real.exp (5 * u / 2) ≤ Real.exp (5 * b / 2) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hEa : Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) ≤
      Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n := by
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
    have ha' : Real.exp (2 * a) ≤ Real.exp (2 * u) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    have hnn : (n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := cast_le_sq n
    have s1 : (n : ℝ) * (π * Real.exp (2 * a)) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (π * Real.exp (2 * a)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnn (by positivity)
    have s2 : π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * a) ≤ π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha' (by positivity)
    nlinarith [s1, s2]
  have hpre : π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * u / 2) *
        Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)))) ≤
      π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * b / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n) := by
    have hpow : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n :=
      pow_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le n
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity)
    exact mul_le_mul h5b hEa (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.exp_pos _).le
  
  calc (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * u / 2) *
          Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))))) *
        |8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 -
          30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) + 15|
      ≤ (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * b / 2) *
            Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n)) *
          (8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 2 +
            30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) + 15) := by
        refine mul_le_mul hpre (hP.trans hQ) (abs_nonneg _) ?_
        positivity
    _ ≤ derivBound a b n := by
        have hpow : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n :=
          pow_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le n
        have h2 := sq_le_pow_six n
        have h4 := pow_four_le_pow_six n
        have hEb0 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp (2 * b) := Real.exp_pos _
        have h5b0 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp (5 * b / 2) := Real.exp_pos _
        rw [derivBound]
        have key : π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 *
              (8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 2 +
                30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) + 15) ≤
            (8 * π ^ 3 * Real.exp (4 * b) + 30 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b) + 15 * π) *
              (n : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
          have hsq : Real.exp (2 * b) ^ 2 = Real.exp (4 * b) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; ring_nf
          rw [← hsq]
          have t1 : 30 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b) * (n : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤
              30 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b) * (n : ℝ) ^ 6 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 (by positivity)
          have t2 : 15 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 15 * π * (n : ℝ) ^ 6 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity)
          nlinarith [t1, t2]
        calc (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (5 * b / 2) *
                Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n)) *
              (8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 2 +
                30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) + 15)
            = (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 *
                (8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) ^ 2 +
                  30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b)) + 15)) *
                (Real.exp (5 * b / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n) := by ring
          _ ≤ ((8 * π ^ 3 * Real.exp (4 * b) + 30 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b) + 15 * π) *
                (n : ℝ) ^ 6) *
                (Real.exp (5 * b / 2) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n) := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right key ?_
              positivity
          _ = (Real.exp (5 * b / 2) *
                (8 * π ^ 3 * Real.exp (4 * b) + 30 * π ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * b) + 15 * π)) *
                ((n : ℝ) ^ 6 * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * a))) ^ n) := by ring

name: XiLab.summable_phiTerm'
statement: theorem summable_phiTerm' (x : ℝ) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => phiTerm' n x)
proof:
:= by
  refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (summable_derivBound (x - 1) (x + 1)) (fun n => ?_)
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
    abs_phiTerm'_le n (by linarith : x - 1 ≤ x) (by linarith : x ≤ x + 1)

name: XiLab.summable_phiTerm'_succ
statement: theorem summable_phiTerm'_succ (x : ℝ) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => phiTerm' (n + 1) x)

:=

name: XiLab.hasDerivAt_Phi
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_Phi (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt Phi (∑' n : ℕ, phiTerm' (n + 1) x) x
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : x ∈ Ioo (x - 1) (x + 1) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hsum : Summable (fun n : ℕ => derivBound (x - 1) (x + 1) (n + 1)) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (summable_derivBound _ _)
  exact hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected (u := fun n : ℕ => derivBound (x - 1) (x + 1) (n + 1))
    (g := fun n : ℕ => phiTerm (n + 1)) (g' := fun (n : ℕ) (v : ℝ) => phiTerm' (n + 1) v)
    hsum isOpen_Ioo isPreconnected_Ioo
    (fun n y _ => hasDerivAt_phiTerm (n + 1) y)
    (fun n y hy => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact abs_phiTerm'_le (n + 1) hy.1.le hy.2.le)
    hmem (summable_phiTerm_succ x) hmem

name: XiLab.differentiable_Phi

name: XiLab.deriv_Phi

name: XiLab.phiTerm'_neg
statement:
lemma phiTerm'_neg {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {c u : ℝ} (hc : (3.156 : ℝ) ≤ π * Real.exp (2 * c))
    (hu : c ≤ u) : phiTerm' n u < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hn2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hEc : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp (2 * c) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hEmono : Real.exp (2 * c) ≤ Real.exp (2 * u) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hx : (3.156 : ℝ) ≤ π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) := by
    have s1 : π * Real.exp (2 * c) ≤ π * Real.exp (2 * u) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEmono hpi.le
    have s2 : 1 * (π * Real.exp (2 * u)) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (π * Real.exp (2 * u)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn2 (by positivity)
    nlinarith [s1, s2]
  have hP : 0 < 8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 -
      30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) + 15 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u) - 3.156)]
  have hpos : 0 < π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (5 * u / 2) *
      Real.exp (-(π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u))) *
      (8 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) ^ 2 -
        30 * (π * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * u)) + 15) :=
    mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _)) (Real.exp_pos _)) hP
  rw [phiTerm']
  nlinarith [hpos]

name: XiLab.deriv_Phi_neg
statement:
theorem deriv_Phi_neg {c : ℝ} (hc : (3.156 : ℝ) ≤ π * Real.exp (2 * c)) {x : ℝ} (hx : c ≤ x) :
    deriv Phi x < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_Phi]
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ, phiTerm' (n + 1) x < 0 := fun n =>
    phiTerm'_neg (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) hc hx
  have hsneg : Summable (fun n : ℕ => -phiTerm' (n + 1) x) := (summable_phiTerm'_succ x).neg
  have h1 : -phiTerm' (0 + 1) x ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, -phiTerm' (n + 1) x :=
    hsneg.le_tsum 0 (fun j _ => by linarith [hterm j])
  rw [tsum_neg] at h1
  linarith [hterm 0]

statement:
lemma le_pi_mul_exp_inv_four_hundred :
    (3.156 : ℝ) ≤ π * Real.exp (2 * (1 / 400 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (201 / 200 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (2 * (1 / 400 : ℝ)) := by

    mul_le_mul h2.le h1 (by norm_num) (by linarith)

name: XiLab.SineTransform.intervalIntegrable_diff
statement:
lemma intervalIntegrable_diff (hanti : AntitoneOn g (Ici (0 : ℝ))) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun s => (g (s + c) - g (s + π / t + c)) * Real.sin (t * s)) volume 0 (π / t)
proof:
:= by
  have hL : (0 : ℝ) < π / t := div_pos Real.pi_pos ht
  have h1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => g (s + c) * Real.sin (t * s)) volume 0 (π / t) :=
    intervalIntegrable_shift_mul_sin hanti t hc le_rfl hL.le
  have h2 : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun s : ℝ => g (s + π / t + c) * Real.sin (t * s)) volume 0 (π / t) := by
    have h := intervalIntegrable_shift_mul_sin (g := g) hanti t (c := π / t + c)
      (by linarith) le_rfl hL.le
    simpa [add_assoc] using h
  have := h1.sub h2
  refine this.congr ?_
  intro s _
  ring

name: XiLab.SineTransform.block_eq
statement:
lemma block_eq (hanti : AntitoneOn g (Ici (0 : ℝ))) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hsin : ∀ s : ℝ, Real.sin (t * (s + c)) = Real.sin (t * s)) :
    (∫ u in c..(c + (π / t + π / t)), g u * Real.sin (t * u))
      = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(π / t),
          (g (s + c) - g (s + π / t + c)) * Real.sin (t * s)
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
  set L : ℝ := π / t with hLdef
  have hL : (0 : ℝ) < L := div_pos Real.pi_pos ht
  have htL : t * L = π := by rw [hLdef]; field_simp
  
  have hA : (∫ u in c..(c + (L + L)), g u * Real.sin (t * u))
      = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(L + L), g (s + c) * Real.sin (t * s) := by
    have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right
      (f := fun u : ℝ => g u * Real.sin (t * u)) (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := L + L) c
    simp only [zero_add] at h1
    rw [show c + (L + L) = L + L + c by ring, ← h1]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => ?_)
    simp only [hsin s]
  
  have hii1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => g (s + c) * Real.sin (t * s)) volume 0 L :=
    intervalIntegrable_shift_mul_sin hanti t hc le_rfl hL.le
  have hii2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => g (s + c) * Real.sin (t * s)) volume L (L + L) :=
    intervalIntegrable_shift_mul_sin hanti t hc hL.le (by linarith)
  have hB : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(L + L), g (s + c) * Real.sin (t * s))
      = (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L, g (s + c) * Real.sin (t * s))
        + ∫ s in L..(L + L), g (s + c) * Real.sin (t * s) :=
    (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hii1 hii2).symm
  
  have hC : (∫ s in L..(L + L), g (s + c) * Real.sin (t * s))
      = ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..L, -(g (r + L + c) * Real.sin (t * r)) := by
    have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right
      (f := fun s : ℝ => g (s + c) * Real.sin (t * s)) (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := L) L
    simp only [zero_add] at h1
    rw [← h1]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun r _ => ?_)
    show g (r + L + c) * Real.sin (t * (r + L)) = -(g (r + L + c) * Real.sin (t * r))
    rw [show t * (r + L) = t * r + π by rw [mul_add, htL], Real.sin_add_pi]
    ring
  
  have hii3 : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun r : ℝ => -(g (r + L + c) * Real.sin (t * r))) volume 0 L := by
    have h := intervalIntegrable_shift_mul_sin (g := g) hanti t (c := L + c)
      (by linarith) le_rfl hL.le
    exact (by simpa [add_assoc] using h : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun r : ℝ => g (r + L + c) * Real.sin (t * r)) volume 0 L).neg
  have hD : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L, g (s + c) * Real.sin (t * s))
        + (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..L, -(g (r + L + c) * Real.sin (t * r)))
      = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L, (g (s + c) - g (s + L + c)) * Real.sin (t * s) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add hii1 hii3]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => ?_)
    show g (s + c) * Real.sin (t * s) + -(g (s + L + c) * Real.sin (t * s))
      = (g (s + c) - g (s + L + c)) * Real.sin (t * s)
    ring
  rw [hA, hB, hC, hD]

name: XiLab.SineTransform.sin_nonneg_on
statement:
lemma sin_nonneg_on (ht : 0 < t) {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hsL : s ≤ π / t) :
    0 ≤ Real.sin (t * s)
proof:
:= by
  refine Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (by positivity) ?_
  have : t * s ≤ t * (π / t) := by nlinarith
  rwa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt ht)] at this

statement:
lemma sin_pos_on (ht : 0 < t) {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hsL : s < π / t) :

name: XiLab.SineTransform.block_nonneg
statement:
lemma block_nonneg (hanti : AntitoneOn g (Ici (0 : ℝ))) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hsin : ∀ s : ℝ, Real.sin (t * (s + c)) = Real.sin (t * s)) :
    0 ≤ ∫ u in c..(c + (π / t + π / t)), g u * Real.sin (t * u)
proof:
:= by
  have hL : (0 : ℝ) < π / t := div_pos Real.pi_pos ht
  rw [block_eq hanti ht hc hsin]
  refine intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hL.le (fun s hs => ?_)
  obtain ⟨hs0, hsL⟩ := hs
  have h1 : g (s + π / t + c) ≤ g (s + c) :=
    hanti (mem_Ici.mpr (by linarith)) (mem_Ici.mpr (by linarith)) (by linarith)
  have h2 : 0 ≤ Real.sin (t * s) := sin_nonneg_on ht hs0 hsL
  have : 0 ≤ g (s + c) - g (s + π / t + c) := by linarith
  exact mul_nonneg this h2

name: XiLab.SineTransform.block_zero_pos
statement:
lemma block_zero_pos (hstrict : StrictAntiOn g (Ici (0 : ℝ))) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    0 < ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(0 + (π / t + π / t)), g u * Real.sin (t * u)
proof:
:= by
  have hanti := hstrict.antitoneOn
  have hL : (0 : ℝ) < π / t := div_pos Real.pi_pos ht
  rw [block_eq hanti ht le_rfl (fun s => by rw [add_zero])]
  refine intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_pos_of_pos_on
    (intervalIntegrable_diff hanti ht le_rfl) (fun s hs => ?_) hL
  obtain ⟨hs0, hsL⟩ := hs
  have h1 : g (s + π / t + 0) < g (s + 0) :=
    hstrict (mem_Ici.mpr (by linarith)) (mem_Ici.mpr (by linarith)) (by linarith)
  have h2 : 0 < Real.sin (t * s) := sin_pos_on ht hs0 hsL
  have : 0 < g (s + 0) - g (s + π / t + 0) := by linarith
  exact mul_pos this h2

name: XiLab.SineTransform.block_k_nonneg
statement:
lemma block_k_nonneg (hanti : AntitoneOn g (Ici (0 : ℝ))) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ ∫ u in ((k : ℝ) * (π / t + π / t))..(((k : ℝ) + 1) * (π / t + π / t)),
          g u * Real.sin (t * u)
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
  have hL : (0 : ℝ) < π / t := div_pos Real.pi_pos ht
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) * (π / t + π / t) := by positivity
  have hsin : ∀ s : ℝ,
      Real.sin (t * (s + (k : ℝ) * (π / t + π / t))) = Real.sin (t * s) := by
    intro s
    have hrw : t * (s + (k : ℝ) * (π / t + π / t)) = t * s + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π) := by
      field_simp; ring
    rw [hrw]
    exact Real.sin_periodic.nat_mul k (t * s)
  have := block_nonneg hanti ht hc hsin
  rwa [show (k : ℝ) * (π / t + π / t) + (π / t + π / t)
      = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * (π / t + π / t) by ring] at this

name: XiLab.SineTransform.first_block_le_partial
statement:
lemma first_block_le_partial (hanti : AntitoneOn g (Ici (0 : ℝ))) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(0 + (π / t + π / t)), g u * Real.sin (t * u))
      ≤ ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..((n : ℝ) * (π / t + π / t)), g u * Real.sin (t * u)
proof:
:= by
  have hL : (0 : ℝ) < π / t := div_pos Real.pi_pos ht
  have hii : ∀ k : ℕ, IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => g u * Real.sin (t * u)) volume
      ((k : ℝ) * (π / t + π / t)) (((k : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) * (π / t + π / t)) := by
    intro k
    refine intervalIntegrable_mul_sin hanti t (by positivity) ?_
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
    push_cast
    nlinarith
  have hsum := intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals
    (f := fun u : ℝ => g u * Real.sin (t * u)) (μ := volume)
    (a := fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ) * (π / t + π / t)) (n := n) (fun k _ => hii k)
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul] at hsum
  rw [← hsum]
  have hnonneg : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range n, (0 : ℝ) ≤
      ∫ u in ((k : ℝ) * (π / t + π / t))..(((k : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) * (π / t + π / t)),
        g u * Real.sin (t * u) := by
    intro k _
    have := block_k_nonneg hanti ht k
    rwa [show (((k : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) + 1 by push_cast; ring]
  have h0 : (0 : ℕ) ∈ Finset.range n := Finset.mem_range.mpr hn
  have := Finset.single_le_sum hnonneg h0
  simpa using this

name: XiLab.SineTransform.sin_transform_nonneg
statement:
theorem sin_transform_nonneg (hanti : AntitoneOn g (Ici (0 : ℝ)))
    (hint : IntegrableOn g (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) volume) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    0 ≤ ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), g u * Real.sin (t * u)
proof:
:= by
  have hL : (0 : ℝ) < π / t := div_pos Real.pi_pos ht
  have hfi : IntegrableOn (fun u => g u * Real.sin (t * u)) (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) volume :=
    integrableOn_mul_sin hint t
  have hb : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * (π / t + π / t)) atTop atTop :=
    Filter.Tendsto.atTop_mul_const (by linarith) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hlim := MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_tendsto_integral_Ioi (0 : ℝ) hfi hb
  refine ge_of_tendsto hlim ?_
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn
  refine le_trans ?_ (first_block_le_partial hanti ht hn)
  simpa using block_nonneg hanti ht le_rfl (fun s => by rw [add_zero])

name: XiLab.SineTransform.sin_transform_pos
statement:
theorem sin_transform_pos (hstrict : StrictAntiOn g (Ici (0 : ℝ)))
    (hint : IntegrableOn g (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) volume) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    0 < ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), g u * Real.sin (t * u)
proof:

  have hL : (0 : ℝ) < π / t := div_pos Real.pi_pos ht

name: XiLab.F_ofReal_mul_I
statement:
theorem F_ofReal_mul_I (t : ℝ) :
    F ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      = 2 * Complex.I * ((∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Phi u * Real.sin (t * u) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpt : ∀ u : ℝ, ((Phi u : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.sinh ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I * (u : ℂ))
      = Complex.I * ((Phi u * Real.sin (t * u) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro u

      push_cast; ring
    rw [h1, Complex.sinh_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]
    push_cast; ring
  rw [F]
  simp_rw [hpt]
  have hcast : (∫ a in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ((Phi a * Real.sin (t * a) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      = ((∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Phi u * Real.sin (t * u) : ℝ) : ℂ) := integral_ofReal
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, hcast]
  ring

statement:
theorem F_ne_zero_of_imag_of_strictAntiOn (h : StrictAntiOn Phi (Ici (0 : ℝ)))
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) : F ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : (∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Phi u * Real.sin (t * u)) ≠ 0 := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ht with hneg | hpos
    · have hp := SineTransform.sin_transform_pos h integrableOn_Phi
        (show (0 : ℝ) < -t by linarith)
      rw [sin_transform_neg] at hp
      linarith
    · exact ne_of_gt (SineTransform.sin_transform_pos h integrableOn_Phi hpos)
  rw [F_ofReal_mul_I]
  exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero)
    (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hJ)

name: XiLab.exists_poly_sq_of_finite_zeros
statement:
theorem exists_poly_sq_of_finite_zeros (hfin : {z : ℂ | F z = 0}.Finite) :
    ∃ Q : Polynomial ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, F z ^ 2 = Q.eval z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, a, b, hP⟩ :=
    exists_poly_mul_exp_of_finite_zeros_of_hasOrderLeOne differentiable_F hasOrderLeOne_F hfin
  refine ⟨Polynomial.C (-(Complex.exp (2 * b))) * P * P.comp (-Polynomial.X), fun z => ?_⟩
  have hz := hP z
  have hnz := hP (-z)
  rw [F_neg z] at hnz
  have h3 : Complex.exp (a * z + b) * Complex.exp (a * -z + b) = Complex.exp (2 * b) := by
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  have hQe : (Polynomial.C (-(Complex.exp (2 * b))) * P * P.comp (-Polynomial.X)).eval z
      = -(Complex.exp (2 * b)) * (P.eval z * P.eval (-z)) := by
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_neg,
      Polynomial.eval_X]
    ring
  have key : F z ^ 2 = -(F z * -F z) := by ring
  rw [key, hnz, hz, hQe, ← h3]
  ring

name: XiLab.lower_bound_setIntegral
statement:
theorem lower_bound_setIntegral {m x : ℝ} (hm0 : 0 < m)
    (hm : ∀ u ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2, m ≤ Phi u) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    m * Real.sinh x ≤ ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Phi u * Real.sinh (x * u)
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hx
  have hsub : Ioc (1 : ℝ) 2 ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ) := fun u hu => lt_trans zero_lt_one hu.1
  have hintIoi := integrableOn_Phi_mul_rsinh x
  have hintIoc : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Phi u * Real.sinh (x * u)) (Ioc (1 : ℝ) 2) :=
    hintIoi.mono_set hsub
  have hconstint : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℝ => m * Real.sinh x) (Ioc (1 : ℝ) 2) := by
    refine integrableOn_const ?_
    rw [Real.volume_Ioc]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hstep2 : ∫ _u in Ioc (1 : ℝ) 2, (m * Real.sinh x)
      ≤ ∫ u in Ioc (1 : ℝ) 2, Phi u * Real.sinh (x * u) := by
    refine setIntegral_mono_on hconstint hintIoc measurableSet_Ioc (fun u hu => ?_)
    have hu1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ u := hu.1.le
    have hmu : m ≤ Phi u := hm u ⟨hu1, hu.2⟩
    have hsx : Real.sinh x ≤ Real.sinh (x * u) :=
      Real.sinh_le_sinh.mpr (le_mul_of_one_le_right hx0.le hu1)
    have hsx0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sinh x := (Real.sinh_pos_iff.mpr hx0).le
    exact mul_le_mul hmu hsx hsx0 (le_trans hm0.le hmu)
  have hconstval : ∫ _u in Ioc (1 : ℝ) 2, (m * Real.sinh x) = m * Real.sinh x := by
    rw [setIntegral_const, Real.volume_real_Ioc_of_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    norm_num
  rw [hconstval] at hstep2
  have hle : (Ioc (1 : ℝ) 2) ≤ᵐ[volume] (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u (hu : u ∈ Ioc (1 : ℝ) 2) => hsub hu)
  have hstep1 : ∫ u in Ioc (1 : ℝ) 2, Phi u * Real.sinh (x * u)
      ≤ ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Phi u * Real.sinh (x * u) := by
    refine setIntegral_mono_set hintIoi ?_ hle
    filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
    exact mul_nonneg (Phi_nonneg (mem_Ioi.mp hu).le)
      (Real.sinh_pos_iff.mpr (mul_pos hx0 (mem_Ioi.mp hu))).le
  linarith

name: XiLab.norm_eval_le_pow
statement:
theorem norm_eval_le_pow {Q : Polynomial ℂ} {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    ‖Q.eval (x : ℂ)‖
      ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Q.natDegree + 1), ‖Q.coeff i‖) * x ^ Q.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x := le_trans zero_le_one hx
  rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => ?_))
  have hi' : i ≤ Q.natDegree := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hx0]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_right₀ hx hi') (norm_nonneg _)

name: XiLab.F_zeros_infinite
statement: theorem F_zeros_infinite : {z : ℂ | F z = 0}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  rw [Set.not_infinite] at hcon
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := exists_poly_sq_of_finite_zeros hcon
  obtain ⟨m, hm0, hm⟩ := exists_pos_lower_bound_Phi_Icc
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, n = Q.natDegree := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Q.natDegree + 1), ‖Q.coeff i‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hC0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C := by
    rw [hCdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
  have key : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → m ^ 2 / 4 * Real.exp x ≤ C * x ^ n := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hx
    have hlow := lower_bound_setIntegral hm0 hm hx
    have hex2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp x := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp x]
    have hsinh : Real.exp x / 4 ≤ Real.sinh x := by
      rw [Real.sinh_eq]
      have h1 : Real.exp (-x) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
      linarith
    obtain ⟨g, hgdef⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ, g = 2 * ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Phi u * Real.sinh (x * u) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hglow : m * Real.exp x / 2 ≤ g := by
      have h2 : m * (Real.exp x / 4) ≤ m * Real.sinh x :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsinh hm0.le
      rw [hgdef]; linarith
    have hFx : F (x : ℂ) = ((g : ℝ) : ℂ) := by rw [hgdef]; exact F_ofReal x
    have hnorm : ‖Q.eval (x : ℂ)‖ = g ^ 2 := by
      rw [← hQ, hFx, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg g)]
    have hub : g ^ 2 ≤ C * x ^ n := by
      rw [← hnorm, hCdef, hn]; exact norm_eval_le_pow hx
    have hlb : m ^ 2 / 4 * Real.exp x ≤ g ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : (m * Real.exp x / 2) ^ 2 ≤ g ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hglow 2
      have hxe : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp x := by linarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg m, Real.exp_pos x, hm0]
    linarith
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => C * (x ^ n * Real.exp (-x))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (Real.tendsto_pow_mul_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero n).const_mul C
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < m ^ 2 / 4 := by positivity
  have hev := hlim.eventually_lt_const hpos
  obtain ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩ := ((eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)).and hev).exists
  have hexp : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp x := Real.exp_pos x
  have hne : Real.exp x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hexp
  rw [Real.exp_neg] at hx2
  have h6 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hx2 hexp
  have hrw : C * (x ^ n * (Real.exp x)⁻¹) * Real.exp x = C * x ^ n := by field_simp
  rw [hrw] at h6
  linarith [key x hx1]

    {z : ℂ | F z = 0}.Infinite ∧

proof:

name: XiLab.exp_envelope_sharp
statement:
theorem exp_envelope_sharp {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (u : ℝ) :
    Real.exp ((b - 1) * u) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u))) ≤
      Real.exp (b / 2 * Real.log b) * Real.exp (-u)
proof:
:= by
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < b := by linarith
  rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
  refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
  set s : ℝ := 2 * π * Real.exp (2 * u) / b with hsdef
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by rw [hsdef]; positivity
  have hlog : Real.log s ≤ s - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hs0
  have hlogs : Real.log s = Real.log (2 * π) + 2 * u - Real.log b := by
    rw [hsdef, Real.log_div (by positivity) hb0.ne',
      Real.log_mul (by positivity) (Real.exp_ne_zero _), Real.log_exp]
  have hsval : b / 2 * s = π * Real.exp (2 * u) := by
    rw [hsdef]; field_simp
  have hmul : b / 2 * Real.log s ≤ b / 2 * (s - 1) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (by positivity)
  rw [hlogs] at hmul
  have hlog2pi : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * π) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three])
  nlinarith [hmul, hsval, mul_nonneg hb0.le hlog2pi]

name: XiLab.mul_log_le_rpow
statement:
theorem mul_log_le_rpow {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    x * Real.log x ≤ x ^ (1 + ε) / ε
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := by linarith
  have hlog : Real.log x ≤ x ^ ε / ε := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 ε)
    rw [Real.log_rpow hx0] at h
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hε]
    nlinarith [h]
  have hxr : x ^ (1 + ε) = x * x ^ ε := by rw [Real.rpow_add hx0, Real.rpow_one]
  rw [hxr]
  calc x * Real.log x ≤ x * (x ^ ε / ε) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hx0.le
    _ = x * x ^ ε / ε := by ring

name: XiLab.norm_F_le
statement:
theorem norm_F_le (w : ℂ) :
    ‖F w‖ ≤ 2 * phiConst *
      Real.exp ((11 / 2 + ‖w‖) / 2 * Real.log (11 / 2 + ‖w‖))
proof:
:= by
  have hw : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖w‖ := norm_nonneg w
  have hb1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 11 / 2 + ‖w‖ := by linarith
  set K : ℝ := (11 / 2 + ‖w‖) / 2 * Real.log (11 / 2 + ‖w‖) with hKdef
  
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))),
      ‖(Phi u : ℂ) * Complex.sinh (w * u)‖ ≤
        phiConst * Real.exp K * Real.exp (-1 * u) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
    have hu0 : (0 : ℝ) < u := mem_Ioi.mp hu
    have h1 : ‖(Phi u : ℂ) * Complex.sinh (w * u)‖ ≤
        phiConst *
          (Real.exp ((9 / 2 + ‖w‖) * u) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u)))) := by
      refine norm_Phi_mul_le hu0 ‖w‖ _ ?_
      refine (norm_complex_sinh_le _).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
      rw [norm_mul_ofReal w hu0.le]
    have h2 := exp_envelope_sharp hb1 u
    rw [show 11 / 2 + ‖w‖ - 1 = 9 / 2 + ‖w‖ by ring, ← hKdef] at h2
    calc ‖(Phi u : ℂ) * Complex.sinh (w * u)‖
        ≤ phiConst *
            (Real.exp ((9 / 2 + ‖w‖) * u) * Real.exp (-(π * Real.exp (2 * u)))) := h1
      _ ≤ phiConst * (Real.exp K * Real.exp (-u)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 phiConst_nonneg
      _ = phiConst * Real.exp K * Real.exp (-1 * u) := by rw [neg_one_mul]; ring
  have hg : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => phiConst * Real.exp K * Real.exp (-1 * u))
      (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))) :=
    (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 one_pos).const_mul _
  have hle := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hg hbound
  have hval : (∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), phiConst * Real.exp K * Real.exp (-1 * u))
      = phiConst * Real.exp K := by
    simp only [neg_one_mul]
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_exp_neg_Ioi_zero, mul_one]
  rw [hval] at hle
  calc ‖F w‖ = 2 * ‖∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (Phi u : ℂ) * Complex.sinh (w * u)‖ := by
        simp only [F, norm_mul]
        norm_num
    _ ≤ 2 * (phiConst * Real.exp K) := by linarith
    _ = 2 * phiConst * Real.exp K := by ring

name: XiLab.rpow_add_const_le
statement:
theorem rpow_add_const_le {c p r : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (c + r) ^ p ≤ (2 * c) ^ p + 2 ^ p * r ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have h2p : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p := Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) p
  have hrp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ r ^ p := Real.rpow_nonneg hr p
  have hcp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * c) ^ p := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) p
  rcases le_or_gt r c with h | h
  · have : (c + r) ^ p ≤ (2 * c) ^ p :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith) (by linarith) hp
    nlinarith
  · have hmul : (c + r) ^ p ≤ (2 * r) ^ p :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith) (by linarith) hp
    rw [Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hr] at hmul
    linarith

name: XiLab.rpow_shift_le
statement:
theorem rpow_shift_le {p r : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (11 / 2 + r) ^ p ≤ (11 : ℝ) ^ p + 2 ^ p * r ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have := rpow_add_const_le (c := 11 / 2) (p := p) (r := r) (by norm_num) hp hr
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) * (11 / 2) = 11 by norm_num] at this
  exact this

name: XiLab.hasOrderLeOne_F
statement: theorem hasOrderLeOne_F : HasOrderLeOne F
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  set p : ℝ := 1 + ε with hpdef
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by rw [hpdef]; linarith
  have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p := by linarith
  set A : ℝ := (11 : ℝ) ^ p / (2 * ε) with hAdef
  set B : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ p / (2 * ε) with hBdef
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by
    rw [hBdef]; positivity
  set C : ℝ := max (2 * phiConst * Real.exp A) B + 1 with hCdef
  have hCpos : 0 < C := by
    have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * phiConst * Real.exp A := by
      have := phiConst_nonneg; positivity
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ max (2 * phiConst * Real.exp A) B := le_trans h1 (le_max_left _ _)
    rw [hCdef]; linarith
  refine ⟨C, hCpos, fun z => ?_⟩
  have hr : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ := norm_nonneg z
  have hb1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 11 / 2 + ‖z‖ := by linarith
  set b : ℝ := 11 / 2 + ‖z‖ with hbdef
  
  have h1 := norm_F_le z
  rw [← hbdef] at h1
  
  have h2 : b / 2 * Real.log b ≤ b ^ p / (2 * ε) := by
    have := mul_log_le_rpow hε hb1
    rw [← hpdef] at this
    have h2ε : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ε := by linarith
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h2ε]
    have hbp : b * Real.log b ≤ b ^ p / ε := this
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hε] at hbp
    nlinarith [hbp]
  
  have h3 : b ^ p ≤ (11 : ℝ) ^ p + 2 ^ p * ‖z‖ ^ p := by
    rw [hbdef]; exact rpow_shift_le hp0 hr
  have h2ε : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ε := by linarith
  have h4 : b / 2 * Real.log b ≤ A + B * ‖z‖ ^ p := by
    have : b ^ p / (2 * ε) ≤ ((11 : ℝ) ^ p + 2 ^ p * ‖z‖ ^ p) / (2 * ε) := by
      gcongr
    rw [hAdef, hBdef]
    calc b / 2 * Real.log b ≤ b ^ p / (2 * ε) := h2
      _ ≤ ((11 : ℝ) ^ p + 2 ^ p * ‖z‖ ^ p) / (2 * ε) := this
      _ = (11 : ℝ) ^ p / (2 * ε) + 2 ^ p / (2 * ε) * ‖z‖ ^ p := by ring
  
  have hrp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ ^ p := Real.rpow_nonneg hr p
  have hBC : B ≤ C := by
    have : B ≤ max (2 * phiConst * Real.exp A) B := le_max_right _ _
    rw [hCdef]; linarith
  have hAC : 2 * phiConst * Real.exp A ≤ C := by
    have : 2 * phiConst * Real.exp A ≤ max (2 * phiConst * Real.exp A) B := le_max_left _ _
    rw [hCdef]; linarith
  calc ‖F z‖ ≤ 2 * phiConst * Real.exp (b / 2 * Real.log b) := h1
    _ ≤ 2 * phiConst * Real.exp (A + B * ‖z‖ ^ p) := by
        have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * phiConst := by have := phiConst_nonneg; positivity
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h4) hnn
    _ = 2 * phiConst * Real.exp A * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖ ^ p) := by
        rw [Real.exp_add]; ring
    _ ≤ C * Real.exp (C * ‖z‖ ^ p) := by
        refine mul_le_mul hAC (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) (Real.exp_pos _).le hCpos.le
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hBC hrp

name: XiLab.hasOrderLeOne_of_gamma_bound
statement:
theorem hasOrderLeOne_of_gamma_bound {f : ℂ → ℂ} {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (h : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖f w‖ ≤ M * (Real.Gamma (‖w‖ / 2 + 9 / 4) / π ^ (‖w‖ / 2 + 9 / 4))) :
    HasOrderLeOne f
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  set p : ℝ := 1 + ε with hpdef
  have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p := by rw [hpdef]; linarith
  set A : ℝ := ((9 : ℝ) / 2) ^ p / ε with hAdef
  set B : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ p / ε with hBdef
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by rw [hBdef]; positivity
  set C : ℝ := max (M * Real.exp A) B + 1 with hCdef
  have hCpos : 0 < C := by
    have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ M * Real.exp A := by positivity
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ max (M * Real.exp A) B := le_trans h1 (le_max_left _ _)
    rw [hCdef]; linarith
  have hBC : B ≤ C := by
    have : B ≤ max (M * Real.exp A) B := le_max_right _ _
    rw [hCdef]; linarith
  have hAC : M * Real.exp A ≤ C := by
    have : M * Real.exp A ≤ max (M * Real.exp A) B := le_max_left _ _
    rw [hCdef]; linarith
  refine ⟨C, hCpos, fun z => ?_⟩
  have hr : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ := norm_nonneg z
  have hrp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ ^ p := Real.rpow_nonneg hr p
  set x : ℝ := ‖z‖ / 2 + 9 / 4 with hxdef
  have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ x := by rw [hxdef]; linarith
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x := by linarith
  have hgam : Real.Gamma x ≤ Real.exp (x ^ p / ε) := by
    have hg := Gamma_le_exp_rpow hε hx1
    rw [← hpdef] at hg
    exact hg
  have hpi1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ π ^ x := Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]) hx0
  have hgpos : 0 ≤ Real.Gamma x := (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith)).le
  have hdiv : Real.Gamma x / π ^ x ≤ Real.Gamma x := div_le_self hgpos hpi1
  have hxp : x ^ p ≤ ((9 : ℝ) / 2) ^ p + 2 ^ p * ‖z‖ ^ p := by
    have hle : x ≤ 9 / 4 + ‖z‖ := by rw [hxdef]; linarith
    have h1 : x ^ p ≤ (9 / 4 + ‖z‖) ^ p := Real.rpow_le_rpow hx0 hle hp0
